title: Synthetic Ascension — Full Tree V4
status: Authored design; structural validation is not gameplay validation.

units.D: one equipped native primary hit before target mitigation, including current item Power but excluding proc-derived damage bonuses
units.L: one baseline dash length (prototype 240 world units)
units.R: short area radius, L/3 (prototype 80 world units)

purchase_rule: Core access AND an owned adjacent node AND requires AND no owned conflict; special Gate/choice/reward rules are defined in the specification.
coefficient_rule: A payload uses its own listed coefficient; coefficients do not multiply down ancestry. An explicitly stated automation or foreign multiplier applies once to that payload.

sources.name: Risk of Rain 2 — proc coefficients
sources.lesson: Borrow different trigger strength for different payloads. V4 defines its own deterministic counter weighting and ancestry rules; it does not claim to reproduce the full RoR implementation.

sources.name: Risk of Rain 2 — Ceremonial Dagger
sources.lesson: The central combat lesson: a generated kill can create the next homing kill. Fresh victims keep chains alive.

sources.name: Risk of Rain 2 — Shaped Glass
sources.status: user reference; page not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified inspiration for power with a severe survival tradeoff. Applied to Zero Armor, Loaded Dice and Danger Close; no exact source numerical claim.

sources.name: Risk of Rain 2 — Gesture of the Drowned
sources.status: user reference; page not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified automation/timing tradeoff. Applied to Automatic, Bottomless and Pressure Vessel.

sources.name: Vampire Survivors — Evolution
sources.lesson: User-specified weapon-plus-catalyst transformation model. V4 uses owned recipes and an encounter reward, with a guaranteed qualified opportunity so a planned prototype route can actually reach its form.

sources.name: Vampire Survivors — Pentagram
sources.lesson: User-specified literal screen-clear inspiration. V4 chooses charge, tells and authored risky variants; it does not copy item deletion or exact immunity rules.

sources.name: Vampire Survivors — Limit Break
sources.lesson: User-specified continued investment after finishing a build. Applied to optional repeatable sinks, without an income cap.

sources.name: Nova Drift — Super Mods
sources.lesson: Specific component prerequisites unlock a transformed mechanic; the developer’s Barrage example combines Burst Fire and Focus Fire. Applied to concrete Fusion and Evolution parents.

sources.name: Nova Drift — Wild Metamorphosis
sources.lesson: Rare offers can invite a pivot. V4 keeps a deliberate tree and puts uncertainty in rewards and items, not in whether a purchased foundational rule works.

sources.name: Slay the Spire — design deep dive
sources.status: developer interview and GDC talk search text reviewed
sources.lesson: Build choices are evaluated in encounter context. V4 uses visible upcoming pressures, opportunities to adapt and powerful combinations rather than trying to make every isolated node equally valuable.

sources.name: Enshrouded
sources.status: user reference; layout claim not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified geographic class-region reference. Applied to three legible Core territories and lateral travel.

sources.name: Path of Exile — passive tree
sources.lesson: A shared passive network supports specialization and broad access. V4 borrows clusters and major changes, while removing ordinary stat travel taxes.

sources.name: Wolcen — gameplay guide
sources.status: user reference; PDF not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified concentric-ring reference. V4 rings communicate scale; they do not impose a linear ring purchase gate.

sources.name: League of Legends — Runes Reforged
sources.status: user reference; archived feature not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified primary/secondary commitment reference. Applied to early native identity and gradual foreign access.

sources.name: Last Epoch — Skill Specialization
sources.lesson: Individual skills have investment trees. Applied to the nine Q mutation webs, with explicit handling when their skill evolves.

sources.name: Mass Effect: Andromeda — profiles
sources.status: user reference; article not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified investment-based pure/hybrid identity reference. Applied to the optional Ascendant state.

sources.name: Grim Dawn — Masteries
sources.lesson: A second mastery provides a full additional investment space. V4 Gates open full regions, followed by explicit authored bridges.

sources.name: Grim Dawn — Devotion questions answered
sources.status: page retrieved; use as structural inspiration
sources.lesson: Source for associating powers with eligible skills. V4 carries explicit Core/shape/trigger eligibility through Fusions and Axioms.

sources.name: Hades — Duo Boon prerequisites
sources.lesson: Named prerequisites from two sources qualify a third effect. Applied to all 27 Fusion recipes, each with mechanically relevant parents.

sources.name: World of Warcraft — Hero Talents
sources.lesson: A connecting progression layer can sit above existing specializations. Applied to three optional boundary Unions, without requiring them to complete each region.

sources.name: Warframe — Focus
sources.status: user reference; page not independently verified
sources.lesson: User-specified Way-Bound export reference. Applied to Axioms, which export one rule and occupy one of three equipped slots.

sources.name: Dota 2 — 7.00 talent introduction
sources.lesson: Milestone talent alternatives inform mutually exclusive discipline forks. V4 keeps fork consequences visible and offers a prototype respec tool.

sources.name: Musashi’s RPG Overhaul
sources.status: page retrieved; use as structural inspiration
sources.lesson: Many specialization combinations inform late build identity. V4 keeps a shared action vocabulary to make combined permissions understandable.

sources.name: Perkus Maximus — original author description
sources.lesson: Spend meaningful choices on mechanics and interactions; short passive progressions can still support them. V4 avoids tollbooth stat nodes, while keeping optional sinks. This is not a claim that the source contains no passive perks.

sources.name: SPERG
sources.lesson: Automatic fundamentals and fewer meaningful choices inform free Core attacks, resource claims, Witness grants and milestone choices.

sources.name: Master of One
sources.lesson: Specialization with drawbacks informs selected forks and Keystones. V4 does not attach a penalty to every purchase or reproduce the source’s perk structure.

sources.name: Vokriinator Black
sources.lesson: Multiple perk overhauls coexist through deliberate compatibility work. V4 embraces breadth and explicitly resolves shared resources, trigger identities and conflicting shapes.

sources.name: Minecraft Passive Skill Tree

sources.lesson: User-specified spoke/cluster inspiration. Used for presentation only; purchase routes remain local loops.

disciplines.name: Execution
disciplines.fantasy: Wound one target, finish it, and turn the body into the next attack. You can build a chain of small deaths or one enormous body bomb.
disciplines.resource: Execute line starts at 10% normal HP. Overkill is damage exceeding remaining HP; an execution also grants a seed of 0.5D so a threshold kill never starts an empty chain.
routes: Domino: EX01 → EX03 → EX04 → EX10, then EXF2. Add EX06 for a second killing family.
Body bomb: EX02 → EX01 → EX05 → EX11, then EXF1. Mark and the Q work while the bomb package is still being purchased.
item_decisions: A low-rank item with an on-kill payload can be worth more than raw Power once Chain Sentence starts feeding it.
Only the Weak rewards a strong opening hit from equipment; a curse that weakens primary damage may need Mark, First Cut, or another opener before it becomes comfortable.

disciplines.name: Momentum
disciplines.fantasy: Draw a route through the horde, leave attacks behind, and turn the next direction change into another hit.
disciplines.resource: Claims the existing Momentum pool: 0–100; gain 25 per L of real travel and 15 per dash, decay 20/s after 0.75s stationary. Each producer runs once even with several claimers.
routes: Flow: MO01 → MO03 → MO07 → MO04 → MO12, then Keep Moving.
Impact: MO02 → MO05 → MO06 → MO10, then Burnout. Every purchase works on ordinary movement or dash before Q.
item_decisions: An existing Momentum producer contributes to the same pool; Afterimage can make a previously unexciting movement item become a damage engine.
A standing-still Manifestation remains usable between movement bursts. Nothing automatically forbids owning both; the player decides whether the alternating cadence is worthwhile.

disciplines.name: Bastion
disciplines.fantasy: Catch incoming pressure, store it, and choose where it explodes. Blocking should feel like loading a weapon.
disciplines.resource: Force 0–100. Prevented or received enemy hits grant 2 Force per 1% maximum HP of pre-mitigation damage, maximum 25 per hit. No decay during inactive encounters; in combat without pressure, decay 10/s after 2s.
routes: Battery: BA01 → BA03 → BA04 → BA08. Full Tank gives a manual payoff before choosing automatic or overpressure behavior.
Catch and throw: BA02 → BA05 → BA06 → BA10, with Guard and Mirror. The entry catches projectiles before Q arrives.
item_decisions: A retaliation or Ward Manifestation can feed the same incoming-pressure loop; health payments never masquerade as enemy hits.
Glass Armor values immediate Force generation; Anvil favors safe hold positions. Owning movement tools remains legal and useful for choosing the next position.

disciplines.name: Precision
disciplines.fantasy: Make one shot take an impossible route. Deliberate lines, returns, and piercing can become as excessive as a bullet storm.
disciplines.resource: Read is a per-target counter. Three weighted Ranged Core hits expose a Weak Point for 3s; the next Ranged Core hit consumes it for +1D. One hit cannot both expose and consume the same Weak Point.
routes: Pierce: PR01 → PR03 → PR04 → PR09. A line opens the next target instead of merely making one shot stronger.
Return: PR02 → PR06 → PR05 → PR07 → PR11. Bank shots and returns create intersecting paths.
item_decisions: One Bullet can turn an extra-projectile item into a large single-shot upgrade while leaving separate on-kill sources intact.
Low projectile speed may be acceptable for returns and crossing paths; it is much worse when a mobile enemy keeps escaping the opening line.

disciplines.name: Barrage
disciplines.fantasy: Build a gun that spills into more guns. You can manage the heat, or arrange for the failure to be the best part.
disciplines.resource: Heat 0–100: native Ranged input adds 8, Witness: Shot adds 4. At 50/75 Heat gain +15%/+30% fire rate and one/two 0.4D side rounds. At 100, Jam for 1.2s then reset to 20. After 0.35s without firing, cool 25/s.
routes: Maintain: BR01 → BR03 → BR07 → BR11, then Cool Head.
Weaponize failure: BR02 → BR01 → BR08 → BR05, then Backfire. Add Ricochet and one recombination after the basic kill engine already works.
item_decisions: High Haste is powerful and also reaches Jam sooner. Backfire can want it for a different reason than Cool Head.
An on-kill item can turn the first Jam into a continuing avalanche. A cooling item can be valuable or interfere with that timing; show both effects in the Run Sheet.

disciplines.name: Ordnance
disciplines.fantasy: Leave something dangerous where the fight is going, then make one explosion call the rest.
disciplines.resource: Shell: 1.5D in R after a 0.6s tell, Proc Power 0.5. Mine: 1.5D in R, arms in 0.35s, lasts 8s, maximum twelve. Coordinates: maximum three.
routes: Shell chain: OR01 → OR03 → OR04 → OR08, then OR12.
Mine field: OR02 → OR05 → OR06 → OR10, then OR11. Both routes can use Designate while waiting for the catastrophe.
item_decisions: Movement equipment changes where Walking Barrage and mines can be laid. A slower but safer defensive item may be right for a stationary objective.
Danger Close can feed a Bastion investment, while Anvil specifically refuses self-damage Force. The combination remains legal; that one conversion is unavailable.

disciplines.name: Invocation
disciplines.fantasy: Build a living field of circles, stored attacks and crossing lines. A prepared network can kill far beyond the next spell you cast.
disciplines.resource: Sigils: radius R, life 8s, one 0.6D pulse/s, Proc Power 0.4, base capacity three. Growth: 0–5 per Sigil, each +0.15D and +8% radius. Echo: a saved Core strike, base 0.6D, Proc Power 0.4. Stored Echoes release toward current enemies when their Sigil expires. Natural expiry releases Echoes but does not cause a detonation.
routes: Growing field: IN01 → IN05 → IN04 → IN10 → IN11. Add Copy Rune and Split Sigils to make bodies feed the network.
Stored burst: IN02 → IN06 → IN09 → IN12, then Off Beat. Consecrate, Open the Vault and Consume provide a manual detonation build.
item_decisions: Inherit the Word gives ordinary on-hit items a second home. Pulse count and native attack damage pull item choices in different directions.
Healing matters to Blood Rune. NEG severity, health-based set effects and existing item Echoes retain their own identities; tree Echo storage does not copy an entire item inventory snapshot.

disciplines.name: Distortion
disciplines.fantasy: Make misses and delayed hits matter. The wave carries unpaid damage until one death sends the bill through everybody.
disciplines.resource: Debt: a saved damage amount due in 2s, Proc Power 0.3, which cannot create Causal Debt from itself. Store up to eight time buckets per target; merge same-source packets into the nearest due bucket while preserving total damage and the earliest due time. Scars: R/2 areas lasting 5s, maximum twelve; overflow merges into the nearest scar. Misfortune uses the existing shared pool, with one fallback 20% combat check if no other owned named chance exists.
routes: Debt chain: DT01 → DT06 → DT09 → DT12, adding DT03/DT08 for the two-status condition. Pass It On changes early kills from a liability into spread.
Lucky defense: DT02 → DT10 → DT08 → DT05 → DT04, then scars. Entry fallback checks make early Second Chance and Bad Luck purchases live.
item_decisions: Combat Luck and acquisition Luck are different consumers of the existing Luck model. Snake Eyes can weaken carefully improved odds; the preview must say so.
Loaded Dice with NEG health pressure can be deliberately dangerous. Coin refunds actual paid health only; kill counts cannot manufacture an unlimited healing pool.

disciplines.name: Dominion
disciplines.fantasy: Turn a scattered horde into a moving object. Pull enemies through each other, tie them together and slam the whole formation.
disciplines.resource: Wells: radius 1.5R, life 1.5s, capacity four; pull normals R over 0.5s, elites R/3, bosses convert resisted travel to stagger. Links: one group up to twelve enemies, life 3s; larger effects may explicitly create a second group. Weight stores resisted pull up to 3L.
routes: Crush: DO01 → DO02 → DO04 → DO08, adding DO06/DO07 for the catastrophe.
Tether: DO05 → DO07 → DO06 → DO11. Add DO12 or Compel to turn linked damage into crowd movement.
item_decisions: A single-target weapon becomes a group weapon through Common Ground and Collective Burden. Its native shape remains relevant to how quickly it builds the group.
Event Horizon can drag you through Danger Close shells; movement items help positioning before its visible final lock. Killing the room is allowed to be dangerous.

nodes.name: Melee
nodes.tooltip: Choose Melee as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate.
nodes.rules: Choose Melee as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate. Only the original choice controls the primary attack.

nodes.name: Ranged
nodes.tooltip: Choose Ranged as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate.
nodes.rules: Choose Ranged as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate. Only the original choice controls the primary attack.

nodes.name: Magic
nodes.tooltip: Choose Magic as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate.
nodes.rules: Choose Magic as the native style, or unlock it through a Gate. Only the original choice controls the primary attack.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.tooltip: Melee Core hits execute normals left at or below 10% HP after damage.
nodes.rules: Melee Core hits execute normals left at or below 10% HP after damage. The execution grants a 0.5D overkill seed. Bosses are never executed. This is one of the three free Melee starter choices.

nodes.name: Mark
nodes.tooltip: A Melee Core hit marks its victim for 3s.
nodes.rules: A Melee Core hit marks its victim for 3s. Your next hit against that victim consumes the Mark and deals +0.5D. Uses the existing shared Mark; one target at first. Works without Finish.

nodes.name: Spillover
nodes.tooltip: Every real Melee kill sends its overkill, or 0.5D if none, to the nearest enemy within 2R.
nodes.rules: Every real Melee kill sends its overkill, or 0.5D if none, to the nearest enemy within 2R. The bolt can kill and create another Spillover. Each real death emits it once. Proc Power 0.7.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.tooltip: Each execution raises your normal execute line by 2 percentage points for 4s, up to +10 points.
nodes.rules: Each execution raises your normal execute line by 2 percentage points for 4s, up to +10 points. Every new execution refreshes the stack duration.

nodes.name: Corpse Bomb
nodes.tooltip: An executed normal bursts in R for 15% of its maximum HP plus 0.5D.
nodes.rules: An executed normal bursts in R for 15% of its maximum HP plus 0.5D. Against elites/bosses, the health-derived part becomes 1D per corpse. Overkill is added in full. Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Cleave
nodes.tooltip: A Melee kill throws a 120-degree slash from the body along your current aim, reaching 1.5R and dealing 0.8D.
nodes.rules: A Melee kill throws a 120-degree slash from the body along your current aim, reaching 1.5R and dealing 0.8D. It may kill and emit another Cleave from a new victim. Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Reservoir
nodes.tooltip: Spillover with no target stores its damage for 4s.
nodes.rules: Spillover with no target stores its damage for 4s. The next Melee Core hit adds all stored damage and releases a 2R line behind its victim. Storage ceiling 8D; excess immediately widens the line, up to 2R.

nodes.name: First Cut
nodes.tooltip: The first Melee Core hit against a full-health enemy deals +1D and applies a 2s wound.
nodes.rules: The first Melee Core hit against a full-health enemy deals +1D and applies a 2s wound. Your next hit against that wound gains 20% execute threshold for that check only. The wound bonus does not stack with itself.

nodes.name: Elite Sentence
nodes.tooltip: Finish can execute elites at half your normal line, capped at 15% elite HP.
nodes.rules: Finish can execute elites at half your normal line, capped at 15% elite HP. Against bosses, a Melee Core hit below 25% boss HP deals an extra 1D, once per second.

nodes.name: Chain Sentence
nodes.tooltip: Your Spillover, Corpse Bomb, and Cleave payloads apply Finish after their damage.
nodes.rules: Your Spillover, Corpse Bomb, and Cleave payloads apply Finish after their damage. New victims can continue their corresponding on-kill chains. They retain the original root cast for charge accounting.

nodes.name: Last Word
nodes.tooltip: Killing a marked victim sends a 2D blade through its position along the Mark approach direction.
nodes.rules: Killing a marked victim sends a 2D blade through its position along the Mark approach direction. It pierces four survivors, can execute through Chain Sentence, and has Proc Power 0.6.

nodes.name: Clean Cut
nodes.tooltip: The first execution following a native Melee input removes the rest of that attack recovery.
nodes.rules: The first execution following a native Melee input removes the rest of that attack recovery. Generated executions instead return 0.15s dash recovery per victim, up to 0.6s per second.

nodes.name: Gavel
nodes.tooltip: Q: after a 0.35s wind-up, strike the aimed point within L for 3D in 1.25R.
nodes.rules: Q: after a 0.35s wind-up, strike the aimed point within L for 3D in 1.25R. Apply twice your current execute line to normals, capped at 60%. Without Finish use a 20% line. Cooldown 7s; Proc Power 1. One cast and every resulting death share a root.

nodes.name: Wide
nodes.tooltip: Gavel radius becomes 2R; direct damage becomes 2.5D.
nodes.rules: Gavel radius becomes 2R; direct damage becomes 2.5D. Wind-up stays 0.35s.

nodes.name: Quick
nodes.tooltip: Gavel wind-up becomes 0.1s and cooldown 5s; radius becomes R.
nodes.rules: Gavel wind-up becomes 0.1s and cooldown 5s; radius becomes R.

nodes.name: Public Execution
nodes.tooltip: Each Gavel execution releases its overkill as one 0.5 Proc Power hit to every surviving enemy in the strike area.
nodes.rules: Each Gavel execution releases its overkill as one 0.5 Proc Power hit to every surviving enemy in the strike area. A victim can contribute once; these hits do not repeat Public Execution.

nodes.name: Drop
nodes.tooltip: Gavel may land anywhere on screen.
nodes.rules: Gavel may land anywhere on screen. Wind-up becomes a 0.7s ground tell; Quick reduces that to 0.35s. All other Gavel effects remain at the landing point.

nodes.name: Second Swing
nodes.tooltip: If the first Gavel strike executes nobody, repeat after 0.35s at the same point for 2D with +10 percentage points to its execute check.
nodes.rules: If the first Gavel strike executes nobody, repeat after 0.35s at the same point for 2D with +10 percentage points to its execute check. Exactly one repeat.

nodes.name: Gather
nodes.tooltip: During Gavel wind-up, pull normals within 2R of its aim point toward the strike.
nodes.rules: During Gavel wind-up, pull normals within 2R of its aim point toward the strike. Move at most R. Elites move half as far; bosses receive 0.5D stagger.

nodes.name: Five Down
nodes.tooltip: Five executions from Gavel or its descendants give +10 percentage points to the normal execute line for 5s.
nodes.rules: Five executions from Gavel or its descendants give +10 percentage points to the normal execute line for 5s. Refreshing this buff never stacks it.

nodes.name: Meat
nodes.tooltip: Corpse Bomb gains +50% radius and doubles its enemy-HP component.
nodes.rules: Corpse Bomb gains +50% radius and doubles its enemy-HP component. Spillover travels only once after each native input; other on-kill families still chain. Corpse Bomb must be owned.

nodes.name: Blood
nodes.tooltip: Spillover gains +R search range and +0.25D per fresh victim, up to +3D for that root.
nodes.rules: Spillover gains +R search range and +0.25D per fresh victim, up to +3D for that root. Corpse Bomb loses its enemy-HP component but retains overkill and its 0.5D base.

nodes.name: Only the Weak
nodes.tooltip: Normal execute line gains +12 percentage points.
nodes.rules: Normal execute line gains +12 percentage points. Your direct damage to targets above half HP falls by 25%. Generated payload damage is unchanged.

nodes.name: One at a Time
nodes.tooltip: Mark may remain on eight targets.
nodes.rules: Mark may remain on eight targets. Marked targets take +50% damage from you; unmarked targets take 30% less. Mark application happens before that hit is evaluated. Marked elites use the full execute line, capped at 20% HP.

nodes.name: Red Mist
nodes.tooltip: Twelve real deaths from one Execution root release a red sweep across the screen for 5D plus remaining stored overkill.
nodes.rules: Twelve real deaths from one Execution root release a red sweep across the screen for 5D plus remaining stored overkill. Apply Finish afterward. Recovery 8s. The sweep has Proc Power 0.2 and its real kills can launch on-kill payloads; it cannot trigger Red Mist again during recovery.

nodes.name: DECIMATION
nodes.tooltip: V: after a 0.4s tell, hit every visible normal for 3D, then execute those below your current line.
nodes.rules: V: after a 0.4s tell, hit every visible normal for 3D, then execute those below your current line. Elites take 4D and bosses 5D plus 1D stagger. Proc Power 0; real kills still fire owned on-kill payloads. Its full descendant tree cannot charge Revelations. Without Finish, this Revelation uses a baseline 10% normal execute line.

nodes.name: Open Wounds
nodes.tooltip: DECIMATION deals 5D instead of 3D to normals before its execution check.
nodes.rules: DECIMATION deals 5D instead of 3D to normals before its execution check.

nodes.name: Body Count
nodes.tooltip: Every DECIMATION execution makes a Corpse Bomb, using EX05 if owned or a baseline 1D bomb in R otherwise.
nodes.rules: Every DECIMATION execution makes a Corpse Bomb, using EX05 if owned or a baseline 1D bomb in R otherwise. Proc Power 0.35. Each body explodes once even if EX05 was already present.

nodes.name: No Time
nodes.tooltip: Remove DECIMATION cast time.
nodes.rules: Remove DECIMATION cast time. Its execute line is 10 percentage points lower for that cast, minimum 0%; spend all Reservoir damage into the initial wave.

nodes.name: Falling Gavel
nodes.tooltip: Gavel becomes a meteor: 5D, a 2R landing area, and a 0.8s tell.
nodes.rules: Gavel becomes a meteor: 5D, a 2R landing area, and a 0.8s tell. Each execution drops one lesser Gavel at the nearest marked survivor for 1.5D. Lesser Gavels may execute and trigger ordinary kill effects, but cannot create more lesser Gavels.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Wide increases landing radius to 3R; Quick halves the tell. Public Execution, Gather and Five Down apply. Second Swing repeats the main meteor only. Drop is absorbed into the unlimited on-screen placement.

nodes.name: Gavel Chain
nodes.tooltip: After the main Gavel, each fresh execution selects the nearest living target and sends a 1.5D Gavel there after 0.12s.
nodes.rules: After the main Gavel, each fresh execution selects the nearest living target and sends a 1.5D Gavel there after 0.12s. Each hop loses 8% of the previous radius down to 0.35R; it can keep jumping through fresh kills. A target receives one chain Gavel per root.
nodes.evolution_mutations: All mutations affect the opening cast. Wide/Quick also set the first child radius/timing. Child Gavels carry Gather at half pull; Public Execution and Second Swing occur only on the opening cast. Five Down counts the entire chain.

nodes.name: Overkill
nodes.tooltip: All Core kills may create Spillover if owned.
nodes.rules: All Core kills may create Spillover if owned. A non-Melee kill uses 60% of its overkill and a 0.3D minimum seed. Capture still occurs only once per real victim.

nodes.name: Slash Damage
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: total direct Melee damage bonus is 1% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: total direct Melee damage bonus is 1% × sqrt(rank). Price for the next rank is 200 × (rank+1)^1.25, rounded up.

nodes.name: Execute Line
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable to rank 30: +0.15 percentage points to normal execute threshold per rank.
nodes.rules: Repeatable to rank 30: +0.15 percentage points to normal execute threshold per rank. Maximum +4.5 points. Next-rank price 400 × (rank+1)^1.25, rounded up.

nodes.name: Stride
nodes.tooltip: Claims Momentum.
nodes.rules: Claims Momentum. At 50/100 Momentum, native Melee arcs gain 20%/40% width. Movement supplied by an enemy pull does not count as travel. Free starter choice.

nodes.name: Passing Blade
nodes.tooltip: Every dash deals 0.6D along a strip R/2 wide and Primes victims for 3s.
nodes.rules: Every dash deals 0.6D along a strip R/2 wide and Primes victims for 3s. The next Melee hit consumes Prime for +0.5D. Claims Momentum; Proc Power 0.6. Works without Stride.

nodes.name: Kill Reset
nodes.tooltip: Real Melee kills return 0.15s dash recovery, at most 0.6s per second.
nodes.rules: Real Melee kills return 0.15s dash recovery, at most 0.6s per second. This shares the same refund bucket with Clean Cut; owning both raises it to 0.9s/s.

nodes.name: Afterimage
nodes.tooltip: At 60 Momentum, a Melee Core strike repeats from its original position after 0.3s for 0.6D.
nodes.rules: At 60 Momentum, a Melee Core strike repeats from its original position after 0.3s for 0.6D. Proc Power 0.5. The repeat does not count as a new native input. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Turn
nodes.tooltip: After travelling L, turning at least 90 degrees arms two crossing slashes on the next attack, each 0.5D over 2R.
nodes.rules: After travelling L, turning at least 90 degrees arms two crossing slashes on the next attack, each 0.5D over 2R. Spend the travelled-distance credit. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Ram
nodes.tooltip: Dashing through a Primed normal carries it to the endpoint.
nodes.rules: Dashing through a Primed normal carries it to the endpoint. Its first collision deals 0.8D to itself and the struck enemy. Elites are moved R/2; bosses take 0.5D stagger.

nodes.name: Running Cut
nodes.tooltip: Travelling L between native Melee inputs reduces the next attack recovery by 40%.
nodes.rules: Travelling L between native Melee inputs reduces the next attack recovery by 40%. Distance is consumed by that attack. Extra distance cannot bank more attacks.

nodes.name: Slipstream
nodes.tooltip: Three distinct kills while moving pause Momentum decay for 2s and leave a 2R lane behind you.
nodes.rules: Three distinct kills while moving pause Momentum decay for 2s and leave a 2R lane behind you. Travelling inside it grants 20% movement speed. One lane, renewed rather than stacked. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Long Step
nodes.tooltip: Hold dash to extend it up to 2L, spending 40 Momentum per L beyond the normal endpoint.
nodes.rules: Hold dash to extend it up to 2L, spending 40 Momentum per L beyond the normal endpoint. The extension loses invulnerability but continues Passing Blade and Ram. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Shock Front
nodes.tooltip: Crossing eight distinct enemies during one dash emits two outward waves, each 2D over 3R.
nodes.rules: Crossing eight distinct enemies during one dash emits two outward waves, each 2D over 3R. Proc Power 0.35. One pair per dash; the cast already deals Passing Blade along its full path.

nodes.name: Trail
nodes.tooltip: At 75 Momentum, a dash leaves its full path dangerous for 1.5s.
nodes.rules: At 75 Momentum, a dash leaves its full path dangerous for 1.5s. It deals 0.4D every 0.5s; ticks have Proc Power 0 and real kills still trigger on-kill effects. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Thousand Cuts
nodes.tooltip: Every third Melee Core strike at 75+ Momentum leaves three Afterimages around the last three enemies crossed, each repeating once for 0.5D.
nodes.rules: Every third Melee Core strike at 75+ Momentum leaves three Afterimages around the last three enemies crossed, each repeating once for 0.5D. No target is required at creation; a copy swings through its stored area. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Lunge
nodes.tooltip: Q: dash up to 1.5L toward the aim and finish with a 2D semicircle of radius R.
nodes.rules: Q: dash up to 1.5L toward the aim and finish with a 2D semicircle of radius R. Cooldown 5s. Counts as one dash and one Melee Core strike; Proc Power 1. Normal dash invulnerability applies only to the first L.

nodes.name: Rebound
nodes.tooltip: The first kill from a manually cast Lunge or its trail grants one free manually aimed return Lunge within 2s.
nodes.rules: The first kill from a manually cast Lunge or its trail grants one free manually aimed return Lunge within 2s. The return cannot grant another return. It shares the first root.

nodes.name: Wake
nodes.tooltip: Lunge leaves a 2s strip dealing 0.6D per 0.5s at Proc Power 0.
nodes.rules: Lunge leaves a 2s strip dealing 0.6D per 0.5s at Proc Power 0. If Trail overlaps it, keep the stronger tick and longer remaining duration rather than duplicating identical ground damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Step
nodes.tooltip: Leave one Afterimage at the start of Lunge; it slashes twice for 0.8D each, 0.3s apart, with Proc Power 0.5.
nodes.rules: Leave one Afterimage at the start of Lunge; it slashes twice for 0.8D each, 0.3s apart, with Proc Power 0.5. Works without MO04.

nodes.name: Fork
nodes.tooltip: Lunge hitting an elite or boss sends two 1D waves from the endpoint at ±35 degrees from aim.
nodes.rules: Lunge hitting an elite or boss sends two 1D waves from the endpoint at ±35 degrees from aim. Each travels 3R with Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Carry
nodes.tooltip: Lunge drags one normal and up to three friendly Mines, Sigils, or Wells it crosses to the endpoint.
nodes.rules: Lunge drags one normal and up to three friendly Mines, Sigils, or Wells it crosses to the endpoint. Existing objects retain timers, ownership and stored damage; none is duplicated.

nodes.name: Long Lunge
nodes.tooltip: Lunge range becomes 3L.
nodes.rules: Lunge range becomes 3L. Endpoint slash radius becomes 0.75R. Long Step can extend it another L using its normal Momentum cost.

nodes.name: Keep Moving
nodes.tooltip: Kills pause Momentum decay for 3s; Momentum is retained between segments.
nodes.rules: Kills pause Momentum decay for 3s; Momentum is retained between segments. Lunge costs no Momentum. Turn and Shock Front retain their ordinary damage.

nodes.name: Burnout
nodes.tooltip: Lunge, Turn and Shock Front spend all current Momentum.
nodes.rules: Lunge, Turn and Shock Front spend all current Momentum. At 100 Momentum they gain +150% damage and +50% area, scaling linearly from zero. On one attack, spend once and apply the snapshot to every simultaneous spender. Refill starts from zero.

nodes.name: Never Stop
nodes.tooltip: Gain a second dash charge.
nodes.rules: Gain a second dash charge. At zero Momentum, primary attack recovery is 40% longer; at 50+ Momentum dash recovery is 25% shorter. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: No Brakes
nodes.tooltip: Momentum may reach 150.
nodes.rules: Momentum may reach 150. Above 100, gain up to 35% movement and attack speed. A sharp turn produces a visible 0.25s skid in the old direction; hitting terrain during the skid spends 30 Momentum and deals 5% maximum HP as self-damage. No hidden turning-radius change.

nodes.name: Blade Storm
nodes.tooltip: Creating six Afterimages within 4s sends six independent cutters through different targets.
nodes.rules: Creating six Afterimages within 4s sends six independent cutters through different targets. Each makes up to four 1D line cuts over 3s, hitting everything crossed; Proc Power 0.35. Recovery 8s. These cutters are not new Afterimages.

nodes.name: BLINK
nodes.tooltip: For 4s, held primary input teleports to a cursor-biased visible enemy every 0.15s and performs a 2D Lunge endpoint strike.
nodes.rules: For 4s, held primary input teleports to a cursor-biased visible enemy every 0.15s and performs a 2D Lunge endpoint strike. A normal can be visited once; elites/bosses can be revisited after 0.5s. Each landing grants 0.1s invulnerability. Proc Power 0.6; all landings retain V ancestry.

nodes.name: All of Them
nodes.tooltip: BLINK also sends a 1D ghost slash to one different unvisited normal after each landing.
nodes.rules: BLINK also sends a 1D ghost slash to one different unvisited normal after each landing. A ghost visit cannot cause another ghost visit. Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: Back Again
nodes.tooltip: After the outward chain, retrace up to twelve landing positions at 0.1s intervals for 1D per strike.
nodes.rules: After the outward chain, retrace up to twelve landing positions at 0.1s intervals for 1D per strike. A durable target may take one reverse strike per 0.3s.

nodes.name: Don’t Blink
nodes.tooltip: Every landing leaves a Shadow Step that strikes twice for 0.8D.
nodes.rules: Every landing leaves a Shadow Step that strikes twice for 0.8D. Only the first landing grants invulnerability; your ordinary defenses remain usable.

nodes.name: Endless Lunge
nodes.tooltip: Each fresh kill by Lunge grants another manually aimed Lunge within 2s.
nodes.rules: Each fresh kill by Lunge grants another manually aimed Lunge within 2s. Damage falls 10% per return to a 0.5D floor; never revisit the same victim. Missing or waiting ends the chain and releases Blade Storm if at least six returns succeeded, even without MOC.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Rebound is replaced by the continued return rule. Wake, Shadow Step, Fork, Carry and Long Lunge apply to every manual return. All returns retain one root.

nodes.name: Crash Run
nodes.tooltip: Lunge spends Momentum to travel 4L, carrying up to twenty normals along its route.
nodes.rules: Lunge spends Momentum to travel 4L, carrying up to twenty normals along its route. The endpoint deals 3D plus the Burnout bonus and emits one 1D Shock Front for every 25 Momentum spent, at most four.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Long Lunge is absorbed into the 4L range. Wake and Shadow Step work normally; Fork adds its elite waves; Carry also moves its three friendly objects. Rebound grants one return with freshly rebuilt Momentum only.

nodes.name: Moving Fire
nodes.tooltip: While moving, each Ranged or Magic Core strike grants 8 Momentum.
nodes.rules: While moving, each Ranged or Magic Core strike grants 8 Momentum. Their first generated payload per strike may spend 20 Momentum for +0.5D. This shared spend occurs after native Momentum spenders, with the remaining pool.

nodes.name: Run Speed
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: total movement-speed bonus is 45% × rank/(rank+60).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: total movement-speed bonus is 45% × rank/(rank+60). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25, rounded up.

nodes.name: Slash Width
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: total Melee width bonus is 60% × rank/(rank+80).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: total Melee width bonus is 60% × rank/(rank+80). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25, rounded up.

nodes.name: Stored Force
nodes.tooltip: Claims Force.
nodes.rules: Claims Force. A Melee Core strike spends up to 20 Force for +0.05D per point and +R/2 radius at 20 spent. Enemy hits supply Force by the shared rule. Free starter choice.

nodes.name: Return to Sender
nodes.tooltip: A Melee Core strike catches up to three ordinary hostile projectiles touching its arc and throws copies back toward their owners for 0.6D each.
nodes.rules: A Melee Core strike catches up to three ordinary hostile projectiles touching its arc and throws copies back toward their owners for 0.6D each. Each caught projectile grants 10 Force. Claims Force; copies have Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: Plate
nodes.tooltip: After 2s without being hit, form one plate.
nodes.rules: After 2s without being hit, form one plate. It halves the next enemy hit and grants 15 Force. It cannot reform above 50 Force. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Full Tank
nodes.tooltip: At 100 Force, your next Melee Core strike discharges it as a 3D nova in 2R.
nodes.rules: At 100 Force, your next Melee Core strike discharges it as a 3D nova in 2R. Q release also discharges it. The baseline does not auto-explode. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Razor Guard
nodes.tooltip: Catching three projectiles within 1s emits a ring of six blades for 0.7D each.
nodes.rules: Catching three projectiles within 1s emits a ring of six blades for 0.7D each. Proc Power 0.4; recovery 1s. Sources include Return to Sender and Guard.

nodes.name: Thorns
nodes.tooltip: Preventing enemy hit damage returns 35% of that prevented damage to its source, minimum 0.2D and maximum 2D per hit.
nodes.rules: Preventing enemy hit damage returns 35% of that prevented damage to its source, minimum 0.2D and maximum 2D per hit. Proc Power 0.25. Reflected damage cannot reflect again.

nodes.name: Surrounded
nodes.tooltip: With four enemies within R, your next Melee Core arc closes into a circle.
nodes.rules: With four enemies within R, your next Melee Core arc closes into a circle. The rear half grants 5 Force per fresh victim, up to 20. A target is hit once by the complete circle. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Vessel
nodes.tooltip: Force above 100 becomes three orbiting plates, 20 Force each.
nodes.rules: Force above the current maximum capacity (normally 100) becomes three orbiting plates, 20 Force each. Each intercepts one ordinary hostile projectile; a discharge fires unbroken plates as 1D piercing blades. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Armor Break
nodes.tooltip: A Force spend of at least 20 applies Cracked for 4s: that target takes 15% more damage from your next five hits.
nodes.rules: A Force spend of at least 20 applies Cracked for 4s: that target takes 15% more damage from your next five hits. Further applications refresh charges to five. Bosses also take 0.5D stagger. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Immovable
nodes.tooltip: While standing still for 0.4s, resist ordinary knockback.
nodes.rules: While standing still for 0.4s, resist ordinary knockback. Resisting a displacement grants 20 Force and a 1D shockwave in R. Recovery 1s; claims Force.

nodes.name: Slow Leak
nodes.tooltip: Force decay leaves one scrap per 20 Force lost.
nodes.rules: Force decay leaves one scrap per 20 Force lost. Walking over a scrap returns 10 Force; an enemy touching it instead causes a 0.8D shockwave. Scraps last 4s, maximum five. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Last Hit
nodes.tooltip: At 50+ Force, a lethal enemy hit instead empties Force and leaves you at 1 HP with 0.5s invulnerability.
nodes.rules: At 50+ Force, a lethal enemy hit instead empties Force and leaves you at 1 HP with 0.5s invulnerability. Recovery 45s. It does not protect health payments. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.tooltip: Hold Q for a frontal 160-degree guard.
nodes.rules: Hold Q for a frontal 160-degree guard. At zero Force it prevents 30% damage; above zero it prevents 75% and spends 12 Force/s. It catches ordinary projectiles, granting 10 Force each. Release throws a 1D, 2R wave. Cooldown after release 4s; release Proc Power 1. Claims Force.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.tooltip: Guard covers 360 degrees.
nodes.rules: Guard covers 360 degrees. Movement speed is halved while holding it.

nodes.name: Counterweight
nodes.tooltip: Release spends half the remaining Force and adds 0.06D per point spent to the wave.
nodes.rules: Release spends half the remaining Force and adds 0.06D per point spent to the wave. Full Tank discharge occurs first if ready, so the same Force is never spent twice.

nodes.name: Mirror
nodes.tooltip: Guard stores up to twelve caught projectiles.
nodes.rules: Guard stores up to twelve caught projectiles. Release fires them for 0.75D each at their original attackers, Proc Power 0.4. Catching still grants Force; hostile projectile damage is never copied at full boss scale.

nodes.name: Bunker
nodes.tooltip: Release leaves a 3s guard at that position using the current shape.
nodes.rules: Release leaves a 3s guard at that position using the current shape. It has 30 Force, cannot refill, and emits a 2D wave when depleted or expired. One Bunker; replacing it resolves the old one.

nodes.name: Martyr
nodes.tooltip: At zero Force, holding Guard may pay 2% maximum HP/s to retain 75% prevention.
nodes.rules: At zero Force, holding Guard may pay 2% maximum HP/s to retain 75% prevention. It stops paying at 25% HP and returns to the 30% baseline. Payments do not fill Force or trigger damage effects.

nodes.name: Living Rampart
nodes.tooltip: Guard spends no upkeep Force while you stand still.
nodes.rules: Guard spends no upkeep Force while you stand still. Movement immediately resumes ordinary upkeep. Small hits below 2% maximum HP grant no Force during the free hold. Release costs still apply.

nodes.name: Pressure Vessel
nodes.tooltip: Full Tank detonates automatically on reaching 100 Force.
nodes.rules: Full Tank detonates automatically on reaching 100 Force. It deals its 3D nova, fires plates, and starts a 1s refill pause. Enemy damage and defense continue normally during the pause.

nodes.name: Overpressure
nodes.tooltip: Force capacity becomes 150; Full Tank waits for a strike or Q release.
nodes.rules: Force capacity becomes 150; Full Tank waits for a strike or Q release. Above 100 Force, take 20% more enemy damage. Discharges gain 0.03D for each point above 100. Full Tank arms at 100; delaying the next strike lets you hold more. Vessel stores only Force beyond the current maximum capacity.

nodes.name: Anvil
nodes.tooltip: After 0.5s stationary, prevent another 20% of incoming enemy damage and double Force gain.
nodes.rules: After 0.5s stationary, prevent another 20% of incoming enemy damage and double Force gain. Moving ends it. Self-damage grants no Force while Anvil is equipped.

nodes.name: Glass Armor
nodes.tooltip: Ordinary armor contribution is halved.
nodes.rules: Ordinary armor contribution is halved. At 100 Force, gain 60% damage reduction, scaling linearly from 0 Force. Force decays twice as fast during its normal active-combat decay period.

nodes.name: Meltdown
nodes.tooltip: A discharge spending at least 100 Force releases three expanding rings over 0.8s, each 2D.
nodes.rules: A discharge spending at least 100 Force releases three expanding rings over 0.8s, each 2D. The second erases ordinary hostile projectiles; the third triggers each owned on-block payload once using a virtual 20%-maximum-HP prevented hit. Rings reach 2R, 4R, then the screen edge. Proc Power 0.25; recovery 8s.

nodes.name: RUPTURE
nodes.tooltip: V: spend current Force and break the whole visible ground after a 0.5s tell.
nodes.rules: V: spend current Force and break the whole visible ground after a 0.5s tell. Deal 5D plus 0.04D per Force spent; erase ordinary hostile projectiles and stagger enemies. Works at zero Force. Proc Power 0; normal kill effects continue with V ancestry.

nodes.name: Aftershock
nodes.tooltip: Repeat RUPTURE after 1s for half its original damage and reverse its knockback.
nodes.rules: Repeat RUPTURE after 1s for half its original damage and reverse its knockback. The repeat spends no additional Force.

nodes.name: Fallout
nodes.tooltip: Every projectile erased by RUPTURE becomes a falling 0.5D blade at a survivor.
nodes.rules: Every projectile erased by RUPTURE becomes a falling 0.5D blade at a survivor. Proc Power 0.3; group every five blades into one visual volley while preserving the five hit applications.

nodes.name: Zero Armor
nodes.tooltip: RUPTURE gains +100% damage.
nodes.rules: RUPTURE gains +100% damage. Your armor contribution becomes zero for 3s afterward; Force-based defense remains available.

nodes.name: Gun Shield
nodes.tooltip: Stored Guard projectiles orbit its rim and automatically fire one every 0.15s at attackers for 1D.
nodes.rules: Stored Guard projectiles orbit its rim and automatically fire one every 0.15s at attackers for 1D. Catching is still limited by the twelve-projectile store. A full Force discharge launches the remainder and triggers Meltdown if owned.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Mirror becomes the orbit store. Bulwark, Martyr and Living Rampart affect the hold. Counterweight applies on release; Bunker inherits up to six remaining orbit shots without copying them.

nodes.name: Bomb Bunker
nodes.tooltip: Bunker lasts 8s and catches projectiles for its own Force pool up to 150.
nodes.rules: Bunker lasts 8s and catches projectiles for its own Force pool up to 150. Tap Q while not guarding to detonate it remotely for 2D +0.04D per stored Force. Holding Q starts Guard normally. Replacing the Bunker detonates it.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Bunker gains the new pool and duration. Mirror stores up to twelve shots inside it; Counterweight adds half its Force again as 0.03D per point without a second spend. Bulwark changes its shape. Martyr/Living Rampart affect only the player-held Guard.

nodes.name: Heavy Hands
nodes.tooltip: All Core strikes may spend Force using Stored Force if owned.
nodes.rules: All Core strikes may spend Force using Stored Force if owned. Ranged strikes add a 0.5R blast; Magic strikes add stagger and 0.5R radius. Foreign spends use half the damage-per-Force coefficient. One spend per strike.

nodes.name: Force Capacity
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: maximum Force gains 3 × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: maximum Force gains 3 × sqrt(rank). Full Tank still arms at 100; Pressure Vessel immediately discharges there, while manual Full Tank can hold up to the increased capacity. Vessel plates begin beyond the increased capacity. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Armor
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: armor contribution gains a total 35% × rank/(rank+70).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: armor contribution gains a total 35% × rank/(rank+70). This multiplies armor rating, not final damage reduction. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.tooltip: Ranged Core hits build Read using their Proc Power.
nodes.rules: Ranged Core hits build Read using their Proc Power. At three points, expose a Weak Point. A hit through that point adds 1D and consumes it. The marker covers the target; precision is in lining targets up, not clicking a tiny anatomical pixel. Free starter choice.

nodes.name: Far Shot
nodes.tooltip: The first Ranged Core hit on an enemy farther than 2R exposes a Weak Point immediately.
nodes.rules: The first Ranged Core hit on an enemy farther than 2R exposes a Weak Point immediately. Its next Ranged Core hit consumes it for +1D. Works without Read; shares the same Weak Point status.

nodes.name: Penetrator
nodes.tooltip: Ranged Core projectiles pierce two additional targets.
nodes.rules: Ranged Core projectiles pierce two additional targets. Each target already crossed adds 0.2D to later hits on that trajectory, up to +1D. Native attacks with no projectile receive no geometric pierce; Witness: Shot creates a real projectile.

nodes.name: Second Read
nodes.tooltip: Consuming a Weak Point causes the next enemy struck by the same projectile to become exposed after its damage.
nodes.rules: Consuming a Weak Point causes the next enemy struck by the same projectile to become exposed after its damage. That target can be consumed on a return or later shot.

nodes.name: Held Breath
nodes.tooltip: Not making a native attack for 0.8s stores Aim.
nodes.rules: Not making a native attack for 0.8s stores Aim. The next Ranged Core strike gains +1D, Proc Power 1.25, and a trajectory preview. Movement is allowed; taking enemy damage removes Aim. A Witness strike can spend Aim but does not reset the native input timer.

nodes.name: Bank Shot
nodes.tooltip: Your Core projectiles may bounce once off terrain.
nodes.rules: Your Core projectiles may bounce once off terrain. A bounced shot deals 75% of its current damage with Proc Power 0.7. The preview shows the bounce if Held Breath is ready.

nodes.name: Return Shot
nodes.tooltip: A Core projectile reaching maximum range or exhausting pierce returns along its travelled path for 60% damage.
nodes.rules: A Core projectile reaching maximum range or exhausting pierce returns along its travelled path for 60% damage. It can hit each victim once on the return. Proc Power 0.5; it never creates another Return Shot.

nodes.name: Overpenetrate
nodes.tooltip: Each unused pierce when a shot turns back adds 0.2D and R/4 width to its return, maximum +1D and +R width.
nodes.rules: Each unused pierce when a shot turns back adds 0.2D and R/4 width to its return, maximum +1D and +R width. With no Return Shot, unused pierce instead creates a 1D endpoint burst in R/2.

nodes.name: Split Line
nodes.tooltip: Killing an exposed enemy after a projectile has crossed another target emits two shots at ±20 degrees, each 0.7D with one pierce and Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: Killing an exposed enemy after a projectile has crossed another target emits two shots at ±20 degrees, each 0.7D with one pierce and Proc Power 0.4. A fresh kill may emit Split Line again.

nodes.name: Dead Center
nodes.tooltip: A native shot whose aim line crosses the central half of a Weak Point target returns 0.25s Q recovery and preserves half the Aim preparation time.
nodes.rules: A native shot whose aim line crosses the central half of a Weak Point target returns 0.25s Q recovery and preserves half the Aim preparation time. Maximum one refund per native input.

nodes.name: Crossing Fire
nodes.tooltip: An enemy crossed by two different projectile trajectories within 0.5s takes an extra 1D.
nodes.rules: An enemy crossed by two different projectile trajectories within 0.5s takes an extra 1D. Outbound and return qualify as different paths. One crossing hit per target per second; Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: Long Game
nodes.tooltip: A returning shot that kills stores one spare round, up to three.
nodes.rules: A returning shot that kills stores one spare round, up to three. Your next native Ranged input fires those rounds from the return endpoint toward the cursor for 0.8D each. Proc Power 0.5; spare rounds cannot store more spare rounds.

nodes.name: Deadshot
nodes.tooltip: Q: slow world time to 35% for up to 0.6 real seconds while choosing a line; release fires a 4D beam across the screen, R/3 wide.
nodes.rules: Q: slow world time to 35% for up to 0.6 real seconds while choosing a line; release fires a 4D beam across the screen, R/3 wide. Default line follows aim. Cooldown 8s; Proc Power 1. Each target is hit once.

nodes.name: Twin Shot
nodes.tooltip: Place two lines during the aiming pause; each fires for 2.5D.
nodes.rules: Place two lines during the aiming pause; each fires for 2.5D. If only one is placed, the second uses the same aim from R to the right of the first origin.

nodes.name: Quick Draw
nodes.tooltip: Deadshot fires immediately along aim, with cooldown 5s and 3D damage.
nodes.rules: Deadshot fires immediately along aim, with cooldown 5s and 3D damage. Twin Shot fires the second line after 0.15s using updated aim, each at 65% of this damage.

nodes.name: Wallbang
nodes.tooltip: Deadshot crosses walls; each distinct obstruction crossed adds 0.5D, at most +2D.
nodes.rules: Deadshot crosses walls; each distinct obstruction crossed adds 0.5D, at most +2D. Beam width is halved. No procedural arena is required to contain an obstruction for the Q to function.

nodes.name: Fan
nodes.tooltip: Each Deadshot line becomes five parallel lines separated by R/3.
nodes.rules: Each Deadshot line becomes five parallel lines separated by R/3. Each deals 35% of the unsplit damage and carries Proc Power 0.3. A target may receive more than one physical line hit.

nodes.name: Recalculate
nodes.tooltip: The first three real kills from the opening beam sequence fire new 1.5D lines from their victims toward current aim.
nodes.rules: The first three real kills from the opening beam sequence fire new 1.5D lines from their victims toward current aim. Proc Power 0.5. These extra lines cannot request more Recalculate lines.

nodes.name: Last Round
nodes.tooltip: Deadshot executes normals below 25% HP after damage.
nodes.rules: Deadshot executes normals below 25% HP after damage. Elites and bosses instead take +1D while below 25% HP. Execute does not require Execution Core access.

nodes.name: Deadeye
nodes.tooltip: Manually aligned central Weak Point hits gain +1D and one pierce.
nodes.rules: Manually aligned central Weak Point hits gain +1D and one pierce. No homing is applied by Precision nodes. Foreign seeking payloads keep their own behavior; the fork does not disable unrelated items.

nodes.name: Smart Rounds
nodes.tooltip: Core projectiles curve up to 30 degrees toward exposed targets.
nodes.rules: Core projectiles curve up to 30 degrees toward exposed targets. A miss may return from the far screen edge once. Core shot damage is 20% lower; return and split payload damage is unchanged.

nodes.name: One Bullet
nodes.tooltip: Native Ranged firing interval doubles; its main projectile deals 3D with Proc Power 1.25.
nodes.rules: Native Ranged firing interval doubles; its main projectile deals 3D with Proc Power 1.25. Extra projectiles from the same volley become +0.4D and +R/8 width each. Independent kill payloads, stored firing points, and later bursts remain separate sources.

nodes.name: Cross-Eyed
nodes.tooltip: Core shots alternate 20 degrees left/right of aim.
nodes.rules: Core shots alternate 20 degrees left/right of aim. Terrain bounces and returns each multiply their current damage by 1.5, at most three multiplications per projectile. Trajectory previews are disabled.

nodes.name: Firing Squad
nodes.tooltip: One projectile root crossing twelve distinct enemies or consuming six Weak Points creates six edge guns.
nodes.rules: One projectile root crossing twelve distinct enemies or consuming six Weak Points creates six edge guns. Each fires a 2D line through a dense lane. Proc Power 0.35; recovery 8s. One Bullet combines the six guns into one controllable 8D sweep lasting 0.8s.

nodes.name: JUDGEMENT
nodes.tooltip: V: slow world time to 20% for up to 1.5 real seconds and place three wide lines across the screen.
nodes.rules: V: slow world time to 20% for up to 1.5 real seconds and place three wide lines across the screen. Release fires each for 5D, width R. Targets crossed by several lines take every hit. Proc Power 0.3; no blanket boss damage cap.

nodes.name: Auto-Plot
nodes.tooltip: JUDGEMENT automatically chooses three high-density lines and fires after a 0.4s tell.
nodes.rules: JUDGEMENT automatically chooses three high-density lines and fires after a 0.4s tell. It prefers different groups, so a lone boss receives one line unless the player removes this mutation.

nodes.name: Back and Forth
nodes.tooltip: Each JUDGEMENT line fires again after 0.5s from its opposite end for 60% damage.
nodes.rules: Each JUDGEMENT line fires again after 0.5s from its opposite end for 60% damage. Both passes carry their own hit events and retain V ancestry.

nodes.name: One Line
nodes.tooltip: Replace three placed lines with one cursor-steered sweep lasting 1.5s.
nodes.rules: Replace three placed lines with one cursor-steered sweep lasting 1.5s. It deals 3D per target every 0.3s, maximum five hits per target. Back and Forth adds a 0.75s reverse sweep at half damage.

nodes.name: Kill Line
nodes.tooltip: Each fresh Deadshot kill redraws one 2D line from the victim toward current aim.
nodes.rules: Each fresh Deadshot kill redraws one 2D line from the victim toward current aim. Those lines can redraw again through new victims. Stop after three consecutive child lines produce no kill, or no live target exists. One emission per victim; Proc Power 0.5.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Recalculate is replaced by the continued rule. Twin Shot, Quick Draw, Wallbang, Fan and Last Round apply to opening lines. Child lines inherit Wallbang and Last Round; Fan makes children three lines at 40% each rather than five.

nodes.name: Smart Grid
nodes.tooltip: Deadshot places four edge guns for 2s.
nodes.rules: Deadshot places four edge guns for 2s. Each fires four 1.5D lines through exposed enemies and the cursor region. Guns share one cast ancestry. The player steers the region; each gun selects its own line.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Fan becomes the four-gun geometry. Twin Shot doubles each gun’s firing count with 65% damage per line; Quick Draw removes setup and cuts duration to 1.25s. Wallbang/Last Round apply. Recalculate grants only three extra lines for the whole cast.

nodes.name: Nothing Wasted
nodes.tooltip: The first missed Core strike from each native input returns once from the far side of its aim: a shot retraces, a slash becomes a 0.8D crossing wave, and a Magic impact repeats at its original point.
nodes.rules: The first missed Core strike from each native input returns once from the far side of its aim: a shot retraces, a slash becomes a 0.8D crossing wave, and a Magic impact repeats at its original point. It uses the original aim and Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Shot Speed
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: projectile speed and maximum travel distance gain 80% × rank/(rank+80).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: projectile speed and maximum travel distance gain 80% × rank/(rank+80). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Q Damage
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: total direct Q damage gains 1% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: total direct Q damage gains 1% × sqrt(rank). Applies to any equipped Q, including Reaction Q. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Heat
nodes.tooltip: Claims Heat and its tier bonuses, Jam and cooling rules.
nodes.rules: Claims Heat and its tier bonuses, Jam and cooling rules. Extra rounds use Proc Power 0.35 and share their volley input. Free starter choice.

nodes.name: Fifth Shot
nodes.tooltip: Every fifth Ranged Core strike arms two extra rounds for the next strike, each 0.6D with Proc Power 0.5.
nodes.rules: Every fifth Ranged Core strike arms two extra rounds for the next strike, each 0.6D with Proc Power 0.5. This count advances once per strike activation, weighted by its coefficient. The rounds do not advance it themselves.

nodes.name: Heat Sink
nodes.tooltip: Ranged Core kills leave a cooling patch for 2s.
nodes.rules: Ranged Core kills leave a cooling patch for 2s. Passing through one removes 15 Heat; each victim leaves one patch. Claims Heat, so the resource works even when entered through a sibling link.

nodes.name: Hot Rounds
nodes.tooltip: Above 50 Heat, the first Core projectile impact in a volley explodes in R/2 for 0.5D and burns victims for 0.2D/s for 3s.
nodes.rules: Above 50 Heat, the first Core projectile impact in a volley explodes in R/2 for 0.5D and burns victims for 0.2D/s for 3s. Burn ticks have Proc Power 0. Claims Heat.

nodes.name: Fragmentation
nodes.tooltip: Every real Ranged kill releases two seeking fragments, each 0.6D, lifetime 2s, Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: Every real Ranged kill releases two seeking fragments, each 0.6D, lifetime 2s, Proc Power 0.4. Fragment kills can release another pair from a new victim. Fragments are ordinary Ranged payloads, not Core strikes.

nodes.name: Crossfire
nodes.tooltip: Every third Ranged Core strike fires one extra shot from a rotating point at the screen edge toward the cursor for 0.8D, Proc Power 0.5.
nodes.rules: Every third Ranged Core strike fires one extra shot from a rotating point at the screen edge toward the cursor for 0.8D, Proc Power 0.5. The counter advances once per strike activation weighted by coefficient.

nodes.name: Coolant
nodes.tooltip: The first kill from each of four aim quadrants removes 10 Heat.
nodes.rules: The first kill from each of four aim quadrants removes 10 Heat. A quadrant becomes available again after moving L. This rewards changing position or using several firing points. Claims Heat.

nodes.name: Loose Chamber
nodes.tooltip: Jamming fires twelve radial rounds, each 0.6D with Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: Jamming fires twelve radial rounds, each 0.6D with Proc Power 0.4. Stored extra rounds from Bigger Magazine, if owned, are added and consumed. Claims Heat.

nodes.name: Ricochet
nodes.tooltip: Core projectiles bounce to one different enemy within 2R after impact, keeping 70% damage and Proc Power 0.6.
nodes.rules: Core projectiles bounce to one different enemy within 2R after impact, keeping 70% damage and Proc Power 0.6. A projectile cannot bounce to the same victim twice.

nodes.name: Pinball
nodes.tooltip: Fragments bounce once to another enemy after their first hit at 70% damage and Proc Power 0.3.
nodes.rules: Fragments bounce once to another enemy after their first hit at 70% damage and Proc Power 0.3. Ricochet kills still trigger normal Fragmentation because they are real deaths.

nodes.name: Bigger Magazine
nodes.tooltip: Crossing 50 or 75 Heat stores three 0.7D rounds.
nodes.rules: Crossing 50 or 75 Heat stores three 0.7D rounds. Cooling below the crossed tier re-arms it. A deliberate vent fires the store toward aim; a Jam fires it radially. Maximum twelve stored rounds. Claims Heat.

nodes.name: Cluster Rounds
nodes.tooltip: Each Core ricochet impact throws two 0.5D fragments even if it does not kill, Proc Power 0.3.
nodes.rules: Each Core ricochet impact throws two 0.5D fragments even if it does not kill, Proc Power 0.3. These impact fragments cannot bounce. Real kills may still create the ordinary Fragmentation pair.

nodes.name: Burst
nodes.tooltip: Q: for 2s, double firing rate and Heat gain.
nodes.rules: Q: for 2s, double firing rate and Heat gain. Keep aiming and moving; release Q early to cancel. Completion vents to 20 Heat and fires one twelve-round 0.6D volley. Cooldown 8s. Claims Heat. Q rounds are Ranged Core strikes, each with Proc Power 0.7.

nodes.name: Sustained
nodes.tooltip: Burst lasts 3s.
nodes.rules: Burst lasts 3s. Movement speed is 25% lower during it. Final volley remains at completion.

nodes.name: Vented
nodes.tooltip: Burst completion also releases a 2D burning nova in 2R and cools to zero.
nodes.rules: Burst completion also releases a 2D burning nova in 2R and cools to zero. Its normal final rounds still fire; the nova has Proc Power 0.3.

nodes.name: Enfilade
nodes.tooltip: Burst rounds gain one additional bounce at 70% damage, with the selected Pinball/Cluster behavior.
nodes.rules: Burst rounds gain one additional bounce at 70% damage, with the selected Pinball/Cluster behavior. Works without BR09; this extra bounce carries Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Three Guns
nodes.tooltip: Two nearby firing points mirror Burst at 50% damage and Proc Power 0.35.
nodes.rules: Two nearby firing points mirror Burst at 50% damage and Proc Power 0.35. They do not create more input beats or Heat. Works without Crossfire.

nodes.name: Ammo Dump
nodes.tooltip: At normal completion, fire an additional round per five Heat held immediately before the vent.
nodes.rules: At normal completion, fire an additional round per five Heat held immediately before the vent. Each deals 0.5D with Proc Power 0.3. Canceling skips both the dump and completion vent. Snapshot Heat once for Vented and Ammo Dump.

nodes.name: Emergency Stop
nodes.tooltip: Canceling Burst during its first half returns half its cooldown and immediately removes 30 Heat.
nodes.rules: Canceling Burst during its first half returns half its cooldown and immediately removes 30 Heat. It emits no final volley, dump, or nova.

nodes.name: Belt-Fed
nodes.tooltip: Each distinct real death during Burst extends it by 0.08s, up to 2 additional seconds.
nodes.rules: Each distinct real death during Burst extends it by 0.08s, up to 2 additional seconds. V-root kills cannot extend Burst; generated ordinary kills can.

nodes.name: Cool Head
nodes.tooltip: Stopping fire between 65 and 80 Heat instantly vents to 20 and arms a +1D opening shot.
nodes.rules: Stopping fire between 65 and 80 Heat instantly vents to 20 and arms a +1D opening shot. Recovery 0.5s. Ordinary Jam loses its Loose Chamber volley. Three successful vents within 10s can trigger Overload if owned.

nodes.name: Backfire
nodes.tooltip: Jams fire twice the normal Loose Chamber rounds and pay 5% current HP.
nodes.rules: Jams fire twice the normal Loose Chamber rounds and pay 5% current HP. They retain the 1.2s firing recovery. If Loose Chamber is absent, a Jam still fires twelve 0.6D rounds. Every Jam can trigger Overload if ready.

nodes.name: Overclock
nodes.tooltip: Heat can reach 200.
nodes.rules: Heat can reach 200. At 100/150 Heat gain +45%/+60% firing rate and three/four side rounds. Take 25% more enemy damage above 100. At 180, force a 1.2s emergency vent to 40, triggering Overload if owned. This is the only replacement for ordinary Jam.

nodes.name: Bottomless
nodes.tooltip: The weapon automatically fires at its normal current firing interval toward aim.
nodes.rules: The weapon automatically fires at its normal current firing interval toward aim. Hold primary input as a safety to stop firing; cooling continues normally. Movement is 20% slower while firing above 75 Heat. Ordinary Jam and Q remain functional.

nodes.name: Overload
nodes.tooltip: Backfire Jam, Overclock emergency vent, or three Cool Head vents within 10s emit four radial volleys 0.15s apart.
nodes.rules: Backfire Jam, Overclock emergency vent, or three Cool Head vents within 10s emit four radial volleys 0.15s apart. Each has twelve 0.8D shots, Proc Power 0.4; Crossfire mirrors each volley once if owned. Recovery 8s. Without a fork/Overclock, the third ordinary Jam within 10s qualifies.

nodes.name: SUPPRESSION
nodes.tooltip: For 5s, three camera-edge guns mirror native shots inward through the aim region for 0.8D each, Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: For 5s, three camera-edge guns mirror native shots inward through the aim region for 0.8D each, Proc Power 0.4. Heat is frozen; ordinary native shots remain ordinary roots, while all added guns retain V ancestry. Sweep is optional; base V rewards firing.

nodes.name: Six Guns
nodes.tooltip: SUPPRESSION has six guns dealing 0.6D per shot, retaining Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: SUPPRESSION has six guns dealing 0.6D per shot, retaining Proc Power 0.4. More hits and firing angles are the intended reward.

nodes.name: Sweep
nodes.tooltip: SUPPRESSION guns fire independently at four shots per second even when you stop firing.
nodes.rules: SUPPRESSION guns fire independently at four shots per second even when you stop firing. Native shots steer the group aim and add no extra mirrored shot while Sweep is active.

nodes.name: Final Jam
nodes.tooltip: On ending, SUPPRESSION fires one 1D radial round per four gun shots emitted, maximum sixty, then prevents native firing for 1.5s.
nodes.rules: On ending, SUPPRESSION fires one 1D radial round per four gun shots emitted, maximum sixty, then prevents native firing for 1.5s. If Overload is ready it also fires and enters recovery. All descendants remain V-rooted.

nodes.name: Heat Beam
nodes.tooltip: Burst becomes a manually swept piercing beam lasting 2s, or 3s with Sustained.
nodes.rules: Burst becomes a manually swept piercing beam lasting 2s, or 3s with Sustained. It deals 0.75D every 0.15s with Proc Power 0.2 and adds 5 Heat per tick. Releasing in the Cool Head band leaves a stationary 1s beam at half damage.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Vented/Ammo Dump retain their completion effects. Enfilade adds one reflected beam segment. Three Guns makes two half-damage side beams. Belt-Fed extends duration within its existing cap. Emergency Stop works in the first half. Heat Beam ignores One Bullet’s volley conversion but retains its item Power.

nodes.name: Bullet Hell
nodes.tooltip: Burst starts with three rotating firing points.
nodes.rules: Burst starts with three rotating firing points. Every third fragment bounce adds another point, up to twelve. Points fire 0.5D rounds at four per second. At completion, consume the points into the Ammo Dump or a baseline four rounds per point, then Jam for 1.5s.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Three Guns becomes the initial three points. Sustained, Enfilade and Belt-Fed apply. Vented adds its nova; Ammo Dump adds Heat rounds to the point dump. Emergency Stop deletes the points without a final dump and grants its cooldown return.

nodes.name: Hot Blood
nodes.tooltip: Melee and Magic Core strikes add 5 Heat.
nodes.rules: Melee and Magic Core strikes add 5 Heat. Their native attack rate receives Heat tier bonuses, and each extra Heat round becomes one 0.4D slash/impact after the native strike. Jam delays all native styles. Claims Heat.

nodes.name: Heat Control
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: Heat generation is reduced by 30% × rank/(rank+75).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: Heat generation is reduced by 30% × rank/(rank+75). This may delay a Jam build’s payoff; preview it as a tradeoff, never auto-buy. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Projectile Life
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: friendly projectile lifetime increases by 50% × rank/(rank+100).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: friendly projectile lifetime increases by 50% × rank/(rank+100). Geometric returns still occur at their stated maximum range. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Impact Fuse
nodes.tooltip: Every fourth weighted Ranged Core hit calls a Shell at the victim.
nodes.rules: Every fourth weighted Ranged Core hit calls a Shell at the victim. At most one Shell is emitted per Core strike activation; overflow counter credit is retained for the next strike. Free starter choice.

nodes.name: Caltrops
nodes.tooltip: Every dash drops one Mine at its start.
nodes.rules: Every dash drops one Mine at its start. Mines trigger on enemy contact after arming, have a twelve-object cap, and work without Ranged attacks. A cap replacement detonates the oldest at half damage.

nodes.name: Short Fuse
nodes.tooltip: Hitting an enemy under a falling Shell advances impact by 0.15s, once per Core strike.
nodes.rules: Hitting an enemy under a falling Shell advances impact by 0.15s, once per Core strike. If that enemy dies, redirect once to the nearest occupied area within 3R. A Shell never chases forever.

nodes.name: Secondary Blast
nodes.tooltip: A real blast kill calls one Shell on the corpse.
nodes.rules: A real blast kill calls one Shell on the corpse. Its kills may call another Shell from a different victim. Proc Power 0.5; one call per victim. Works with either Shells or Mines.

nodes.name: Mine Toss
nodes.tooltip: A Core projectile touching an unarmed Mine pushes it up to R toward aim.
nodes.rules: A Core projectile touching an unarmed Mine pushes it up to R toward aim. The Mine gains +0.5D if it travels at least R/2. It arms at the end of the push even if the timer would otherwise be longer.

nodes.name: Chain Reaction
nodes.tooltip: A Mine blast detonates every armed Mine whose radius it touches.
nodes.rules: A Mine blast detonates every armed Mine whose radius it touches. Remove each Mine from the live graph before resolving its explosion. Every Mine explodes once.

nodes.name: Blast Pull
nodes.tooltip: The outer half of a blast pulls normals R/2 toward its center after damage.
nodes.rules: The outer half of a blast pulls normals R/2 toward its center after damage. The next distinct blast can hit them at full strength. Elites move R/4; bosses receive 0.25D stagger.

nodes.name: Fracture
nodes.tooltip: Three distinct blasts on one target arm Fracture.
nodes.rules: Three distinct blasts on one target arm Fracture. The next blast consumes it and sends three 0.6D shrapnel shots along incoming blast directions. Proc Power 0.35; one Fracture stack per blast activation.

nodes.name: Walking Barrage
nodes.tooltip: After travelling L, call a Shell R behind your position.
nodes.rules: After travelling L, call a Shell R behind your position. The travelled-distance credit is spent; maximum one call per 0.5s. Walking and dashing count; enemy displacement does not.

nodes.name: Magazine
nodes.tooltip: Mine cap rises to eighteen.
nodes.rules: Mine cap rises to eighteen. Replaced Mines explode at full power. A Coordinate replaced beyond its three-object cap fires one Shell before disappearing.

nodes.name: Saturation Scan
nodes.tooltip: The first blast kill after moving R marks the densest occupied cell within 3R for three Shells, 0.2s apart.
nodes.rules: The first blast kill after moving R marks the densest occupied cell within 3R for three Shells, 0.2s apart. It scans on that kill, never continuously. Those kills can trigger other on-kill effects.

nodes.name: Big One
nodes.tooltip: Every seventh Shell becomes 4D in 2R with a 0.9s tell and Proc Power 1.
nodes.rules: Every seventh Shell becomes 4D in 2R with a 0.9s tell and Proc Power 1. A Big One counts once toward ordinary Shell counters and cannot be duplicated by source-copy effects. Mines do not advance this counter.

nodes.name: Designate
nodes.tooltip: Q on empty ground places a Coordinate within the screen, up to three; placement recovery 0.25s.
nodes.rules: Q on empty ground places a Coordinate within the screen, up to three; placement recovery 0.25s. Q on a Coordinate calls four Shells at 0.2s intervals and consumes it. Firing cooldown 7s, shared by all Coordinates. Holding Q for 0.35s on empty ground places and immediately fires one.

nodes.name: Saturation
nodes.tooltip: Each Designate sequence calls seven Shells spread across a 3R circle rather than four at one point.
nodes.rules: Each Designate sequence calls seven Shells spread across a 3R circle rather than four at one point.

nodes.name: Homing
nodes.tooltip: Each Designate sequence calls three 2.5D Shells that track a chosen enemy until their final 0.15s landing tell.
nodes.rules: Each Designate sequence calls three 2.5D Shells that track a chosen enemy until their final 0.15s landing tell.

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.tooltip: Each distinct kill by a Designate sequence adds one Shell to it, up to six additions per activated Coordinate.
nodes.rules: Each distinct kill by a Designate sequence adds one Shell to it, up to six additions per activated Coordinate. Descendants from Secondary Blast count if they retain this sequence root.

nodes.name: Proximity
nodes.tooltip: Designate Shells land as armed traps for 3s and explode on contact or expiry.
nodes.rules: Designate Shells land as armed traps for 3s and explode on contact or expiry. They use a separate maximum of twenty-four traps; replacement resolves the oldest. Falling impacts deal no damage until detonation.

nodes.name: Walking Target
nodes.tooltip: The selected Coordinate follows at an aim-set offset from you, up to L.
nodes.rules: The selected Coordinate follows at an aim-set offset from you, up to L. Its fired sequence follows that point. Existing traps remain where they landed.

nodes.name: All Coordinates
nodes.tooltip: Firing one Coordinate starts every current Coordinate in creation order, 0.2s apart, for the same cooldown.
nodes.rules: Firing one Coordinate starts every current Coordinate in creation order, 0.2s apart, for the same cooldown. The cast shares one root; each Coordinate keeps its own Cascade allowance.

nodes.name: Fire Again
nodes.tooltip: Fired Coordinates become dormant instead of disappearing.
nodes.rules: Fired Coordinates become dormant instead of disappearing. They reactivate when the Q cooldown completes. Replacing a dormant Coordinate removes it normally.

nodes.name: Carpet Fire
nodes.tooltip: Automatic Shells select different occupied cells before reusing one.
nodes.rules: Automatic Shells select different occupied cells before reusing one. Three distinct blast kills within 1s call an extra Shell at the least-covered group. Each Shell deals 15% less direct damage; extra calls carry Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: Guidance
nodes.tooltip: Your latest Core hit on an elite/boss makes it the automatic Shell target for 4s.
nodes.rules: Your latest Core hit on an elite/boss makes it the automatic Shell target for 4s. Automatic Shells gain +50% damage against it; every second automatic Shell is suppressed and its counters are not advanced. Manual Designate remains independent.

nodes.name: Spotter
nodes.tooltip: Three distinct blasts mark a durable target as a Beacon for 5s.
nodes.rules: Three distinct blasts mark a durable target as a Beacon for 5s. Every 0.8s it receives a 1D Shell; landing another distinct non-Spotter blast refreshes duration. Maximum three Beacons. All other Shell damage is 15% lower.

nodes.name: Danger Close
nodes.tooltip: Blasts gain +40% radius and +25% damage.
nodes.rules: Blasts gain +40% radius and +25% damage. Your own blast hit pays 3% maximum HP as actual self-damage, maximum one self-hit per 0.25s; mitigation applies. It may fill Force or trigger retaliation, but a self-hit cannot create another blast until a real enemy interaction occurs.

nodes.name: Rolling Thunder
nodes.tooltip: Twelve blast activations within one root draw six lanes across the visible field and land four 2D Shells along each lane over 1s.
