nodes.rules: Twelve blast activations within one root draw six lanes across the visible field and land four 2D Shells along each lane over 1s. Armed Mines touched by lanes detonate. Proc Power 0.3; recovery 8s. Each Shell can continue ordinary kill families.

nodes.name: FIRE MISSION
nodes.tooltip: After a 1s grid tell, twenty-four 3D Shells land across occupied screen cells over 1s.
nodes.rules: After a 1s grid tell, twenty-four 3D Shells land across occupied screen cells over 1s. Target assignment spreads across groups before repeating; at least four can strike a lone boss. Proc Power 0.25. All Shells and descendants retain V ancestry.

nodes.name: No Safe Ground
nodes.tooltip: FIRE MISSION uses forty-eight Shells and includes gaps between occupied cells.
nodes.rules: FIRE MISSION uses forty-eight Shells and includes gaps between occupied cells. Danger Close can hurt you anywhere on screen; the complete danger grid is visible before impact.

nodes.name: Firewalk
nodes.tooltip: FIRE MISSION follows behind your movement and leaves a safe 1.5R corridor ahead for its duration.
nodes.rules: FIRE MISSION follows behind your movement and leaves a safe 1.5R corridor ahead for its duration. Stopping preserves the last safe direction.

nodes.name: Second Salvo
nodes.tooltip: Repeat the mission after 2s at 60% damage, targeting the current survivors.
nodes.rules: Repeat the mission after 2s at 60% damage, targeting the current survivors. It shares V ancestry and does not spend another meter.

nodes.name: Carpet Bomb
nodes.tooltip: Activated Coordinates follow the player for 3s, each dropping one ordinary Shell every 0.3s behind the route.
nodes.rules: Activated Coordinates follow the player for 3s, each dropping one ordinary Shell every 0.3s behind the route. Stopping for 0.3s causes each to fire its remaining Shell allowance at once. The base allowance is ten per Coordinate.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Saturation adds six Shells per Coordinate. Cascade adds up to six more. Proximity applies to landings. Walking Target sets the offset; All Coordinates activates all three; Fire Again leaves them dormant afterward.

nodes.name: Bunker Buster
nodes.tooltip: Every activated Coordinate attaches to the chosen durable target.
nodes.rules: Every activated Coordinate attaches to the chosen durable target. Their sequences combine into one 8D Shell per Coordinate in 2R after a 1s tell. The final 0.2s position is fixed, so a fast target can still escape without preparation.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Homing becomes target attachment. Cascade adds +0.5D per qualifying kill, at most six per Coordinate. Proximity leaves the combined Shell armed. Walking Target is suspended while attached and resumes when unassigned. All Coordinates/Fire Again retain their behavior.

nodes.name: Fuse
nodes.tooltip: Any Q that does not already create Shells leaves one Shell at its endpoint.
nodes.rules: Any Q that does not already create Shells leaves one Shell at its endpoint. A Shell-producing Q instead advances Big One by one, if owned. One grant per actual Q activation, including a Reaction Q; repeats within it do not grant another.

nodes.name: Blast Damage
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: blast damage gains 1% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: blast damage gains 1% × sqrt(rank). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Blast Radius
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: blast radius gains 70% × rank/(rank+95).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: blast radius gains 70% × rank/(rank+95). Radius, not area, is modified; Danger Close previews the enlarged self-hit area. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Leave a Sigil
nodes.tooltip: Every fourth weighted Magic Core hit places a Sigil at that enemy; at most one placement per Core activation, with excess progress banked.
nodes.rules: Every fourth weighted Magic Core hit places a Sigil at that enemy; at most one placement per Core activation, with excess progress banked. At capacity replace the oldest. Eligible free starter.

nodes.name: Stretch Sigil
nodes.tooltip: After travelling L, the next Magic Core impact places a Sigil if none exists; otherwise stretch the nearest Sigil toward that impact by up to R until its next pulse.
nodes.rules: After travelling L, the next Magic Core impact places a Sigil if none exists; otherwise stretch the nearest Sigil toward that impact by up to R until its next pulse. Overlapping edges exchange one stored Echo without copying it. This entry works without Leave a Sigil.

nodes.name: Endure
nodes.tooltip: Standing inside a Sigil pauses its expiry by spending one Growth/s.
nodes.rules: Standing inside a Sigil pauses its expiry by spending one Growth/s. An empty Sigil resumes expiry. Pulse timing is unaffected.

nodes.name: Congregation
nodes.tooltip: Touching Sigils share kill-growth awards among their least-grown members instead of each claiming the same kill.
nodes.rules: Touching Sigils share kill-growth awards among their least-grown members instead of each claiming the same kill. Each connected parent beyond the first adds one Sigil slot, up to three extra slots. Losing the connection does not delete existing Sigils; it prevents new excess placements.

nodes.name: Fed by Death
nodes.tooltip: A real death within 1.5R of a Sigil grants one Growth.
nodes.rules: A real death within 1.5R of a Sigil grants one Growth. A generated kill grants 0.5 Growth. Fractional Growth is stored; damage and radius use the actual amount.

nodes.name: Echo Shrine
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core strike made inside a Sigil stores one Echo of its geometry.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core strike made while inside a Sigil stores one Echo of its strike. Each Sigil stores three; the fourth releases the oldest. Store at most one Echo per Core activation, selecting the least-full containing Sigil. Echoes cannot store Echoes.

nodes.name: Warm Circle
nodes.tooltip: Once per 2s, suffering an enemy hit inside a grown Sigil consumes one Growth to prevent 35% of that hit and store one 0.8D Echo.
nodes.rules: Once per 2s, suffering an enemy hit inside a grown Sigil consumes one Growth to prevent 35% of that hit and store one 0.8D Echo. Provides a one-Echo store if Echo Shrine is absent.

nodes.name: Off Beat
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core impact in a Sigil’s outer third advances its next pulse by 0.4s.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core impact in a Sigil’s outer third advances its next pulse by 0.4s. An impact in its center delays it by 0.2s and gives its next Echo +0.4D. One adjustment per Sigil per Core activation; the pulse cannot be delayed beyond 2s.

nodes.name: Detonate Sigil
nodes.tooltip: Replacing a Sigil, or adding Growth to an already full one, causes a 1.5D +0.3D-per-Growth explosion and releases its Echoes.
nodes.rules: Replacing a Sigil, or adding Growth to an already full one, causes a 1.5D +0.3D-per-Growth explosion and releases its Echoes. Growth overflow detonation spends three Growth and preserves the Sigil; replacement destroys it. Proc Power 0.5. A Sigil can detonate once per uninterrupted hit path; a later real death can grow it again.

nodes.name: Chain Pulse
nodes.tooltip: A pulse that hits six distinct enemies commands the nearest unpulsed Sigil to pulse immediately.
nodes.rules: A pulse that hits six distinct enemies commands the nearest unpulsed Sigil to pulse immediately. Each Sigil joins this pulse chain once. Killing a new enemy may start other kill families, but does not clear this chain’s visited-Sigil set.

nodes.name: Copy Rune
nodes.tooltip: Reaching five Growth creates one child Sigil toward the nearest cluster, at half pulse damage and half radius.
nodes.rules: Reaching five Growth creates one child Sigil toward the nearest cluster, at half pulse damage and half radius. A parent may have one living child; children cannot create children. Each child has one Echo slot, lasts 6s and uses the shared Sigil capacity.

nodes.name: Home Rune
nodes.tooltip: The newest parent Sigil follows you at 0.5L/s, stopping R away.
nodes.rules: The newest parent Sigil follows you at 0.5L/s, stopping R away. Touching another Sigil pulses both once, then requires 1s separated before the same pair can do it again. Echoes exchange without duplication.

nodes.name: Consecrate
nodes.tooltip: Q: place one Sigil at the cursor within 3L, then command all living Sigils to pulse.
nodes.rules: Q: place one Sigil at the cursor within 3L, then command all living Sigils to pulse. Recovery 7s. Works with no existing Sigils. Base Sigil rules are granted with Q.

nodes.name: Great Sigil
nodes.tooltip: The placed Sigil has 2R radius, 1.5D pulses and six Echo slots, but occupies two Sigil slots.
nodes.rules: The placed Sigil has 2R radius, 1.5D pulses and six Echo slots, but occupies two Sigil slots. It receives ordinary Growth. If only one slot is available, replace enough old Sigils to fit it.

nodes.name: Open the Vault
nodes.tooltip: Consecrate releases all stored Echoes after commanding its pulses.
nodes.rules: Consecrate releases all stored Echoes after commanding its pulses. Released Echoes preserve their original Core geometry and use current targets.

nodes.name: Wandering Sigil
nodes.tooltip: The newly placed Sigil follows the cursor at L/s within 3L of you.
nodes.rules: The newly placed Sigil follows the cursor at L/s within 3L of you. With Swarm, the triangle moves as one formation. It stops moving if Consume leaves no new Sigil alive.

nodes.name: Swarm
nodes.tooltip: Place three Sigils in a triangle instead of one.
nodes.rules: Place three Sigils in a triangle instead of one. Each has 0.7R radius and 0.4D pulses at Proc Power 0.3. These are parents, occupy one slot each, and can grow or split.

nodes.name: Consume
nodes.tooltip: Before placing the new Sigil, destroy the old network and release its remaining scheduled pulses over 1s at the cursor: floor(remaining life / pulse interval) pulses per Sigil, plus its Echoes.
nodes.rules: Before placing the new Sigil, destroy the old network and release its remaining scheduled pulses over 1s at the cursor: floor(remaining life / pulse interval) pulses per Sigil, plus its Echoes. Endure pauses are not future stored life. This is destruction, not replacement; Detonate Sigil adds one explosion per destroyed Sigil. New Consecrate placements survive.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.tooltip: Each commanded Sigil draws a 0.5D line to every other commanded Sigil.
nodes.rules: Each commanded Sigil draws a 0.5D line to every other commanded Sigil. Each unordered pair creates one line. An enemy can be hit by every different line; each line has Proc Power 0.25. This is a named attack, separate from the existing item Resonance system.

nodes.name: Roaming Sigils
nodes.tooltip: All parent Sigils move at 0.7L/s toward nearby enemies and aim each pulse as a 2R cone.
nodes.rules: All parent Sigils move at 0.7L/s toward nearby enemies and aim each pulse as a 2R cone. Radius and kill Growth are reduced by 25%. Home Rune stays near you; cursor-directed Consecrate placements follow their cursor instead. Children remain small stationary circles.

nodes.name: Split Sigils
nodes.tooltip: A full parent creates two children instead of one.
nodes.rules: A full parent creates two children instead of one. Children may command Chain Pulse and share the parent’s Growth, but cannot breed. Replacing the parent detonates its children for 1D each, then removes them. Parents remain fixed; Home Rune moves only the newest parent at 0.25L/s.

nodes.name: Inherit the Word
nodes.tooltip: Sigil pulses can trigger owned Magic Core on-hit rules at their listed Proc Power, including advancement toward Leave a Sigil.
nodes.rules: Sigil pulses can trigger owned Magic Core on-hit rules at their listed Proc Power, including advancement toward Leave a Sigil. They are still generated hits and never count as a native input. Native Magic strike damage is reduced by 25%. Recursive pulse→Sigil creation uses the hit-path rule; new real kills can continue independent families.

nodes.name: Blood Rune
nodes.tooltip: Every native Magic attack can place one Sigil instead of waiting for four hits.
nodes.rules: Every native Magic attack can place one Sigil instead of waiting for four hits. Each placement pays 3% current HP and starts with two Growth. Stop blood placement at 25% maximum HP; ordinary sources still work. Healing received is reduced by 25% while a blood-placed Sigil lives.

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.tooltip: If at least three living Sigils have each gained Growth, the next Chain Pulse becomes Choir.
nodes.rules: If at least three living Sigils have each gained Growth, the next Chain Pulse becomes Choir. All Sigils pulse, release one Echo and draw a 1D line to the next Sigil in creation order. A line kill detonates the nearest not-yet-detonated Sigil without destroying it for 2D. Each Sigil detonates once in this Choir. Recovery 8s; Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: THE HOST
nodes.tooltip: For 6s, duplicate each Sigil once and triple pulse speed for originals and copies.
nodes.rules: For 6s, duplicate each Sigil once and triple pulse speed for originals and copies. If fewer than three parents exist, first place temporary blank parents around occupied screen thirds. Copies use half damage and Proc Power 0.2, do not consume ordinary slots and cannot breed. All accelerated pulses, copy attacks and end-of-state Echo releases retain V ancestry. There is no special boss damage cap.

nodes.name: Full Choir
nodes.tooltip: THE HOST starts and ends with Choir, bypassing Choir recovery.
nodes.rules: THE HOST starts and ends with Choir, bypassing Choir recovery. If Choir is not owned, use its pulse-and-line attack without kill detonations. Both remain part of the V root; neither refunds Revelation charge.

nodes.name: March
nodes.tooltip: Originals advance toward the cursor at L/s while copies move away, stretching network lines.
nodes.rules: Originals advance toward the cursor at L/s while copies move away, stretching network lines. This temporary command overrides stationary fork restrictions for THE HOST’s duration.

nodes.name: One Voice
nodes.tooltip: Replace the temporary duplication with one screen-sized Sigil pulsing once/s.
nodes.rules: Replace the temporary duplication with one screen-sized Sigil pulsing once/s. Each pulse combines 60% of the damage of all originals’ ordinary pulses, minimum 3D, at Proc Power 1. Store originals until the state ends, preserving life and Growth; all Echoes release at the final pulse.

nodes.name: Mobile Choir
nodes.tooltip: Consecrate forms its new Sigils into a moving band around you for 6s.
nodes.rules: Consecrate forms its new Sigils into a moving band around you for 6s. Each pulse also sends a 0.8D wave toward the next member, and the band moves at your speed. The rest of the network still receives the opening command.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Great enlarges the central member; Swarm gives three members. Open the Vault releases Echoes. Consume burns the previous network and leaves the band. Resonance adds its ordinary crossing lines.

nodes.name: Sigil Web
nodes.tooltip: Consecrate connects all parents and children for 4s regardless of distance on camera.
nodes.rules: Consecrate connects all parents and children for 4s regardless of distance on camera. A pulse also travels along the two nearest links for 0.5D per edge, each edge once per pulse chain. Network deaths share Growth normally and may start Choir.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Great/Swarm decide new anchors. Open the Vault releases stored Echoes. Wandering moves only newly placed anchors. Consume releases the old web before creating the new anchors; it does not leave invisible old links.

nodes.name: Echo Chamber
nodes.tooltip: Native attacks of any Core made inside a Sigil can store Echoes through Echo Shrine.
nodes.rules: Native attacks of any Core made inside a Sigil can store Echoes through Echo Shrine. Foreign Echoes use the actual melee arc, ranged projectile or magic impact, at 0.6D and Proc Power 0.4. Their original effects use the normal generated-hit rules.

nodes.name: Sigil Life
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: Sigil life gains 0.25s × sqrt(rank), and pulse damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: Sigil life gains 0.25s × sqrt(rank), and pulse damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Sigil Size
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: radius gains a total 80% × rank/(rank+105).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: radius gains a total 80% × rank/(rank+105). Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Twice
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core strike makes a named 20% combat roll to repeat its geometry after 0.35s for 50% damage, Proc Power 0.5.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core strike makes a named 20% combat roll to repeat its geometry after 0.35s for 50% damage, Proc Power 0.5. The repeat can trigger other effects but cannot roll Twice on the same hit path. Eligible free starter.

nodes.name: Second Chance
nodes.tooltip: The first failed named combat roll per Core activation rerolls once.
nodes.rules: The first failed named combat roll per Core activation rerolls once. A reroll success leaves a scar at its target. Owning this node alone grants a fallback 20% roll on a Magic Core hit to create a 0.4D delayed impact; remove that fallback when another eligible chance is owned. Loot and Coin face selection are excluded.

nodes.name: Residue
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core hit gives Fading: 0.15D/s for 2s.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core hit gives Fading: 0.15D/s for 2s. When an ordinary damage-over-time or slow status expires, leave a scar containing one second of its last rate, minimum 0.3D; the target can leave one scar per 1s. Controls, Revelation states and auras do not qualify. This node supplies its own status.

nodes.name: Misfire
nodes.tooltip: Each distinct ordinary hostile projectile entering R of you makes one named 15% roll to vanish and leave a scar.
nodes.rules: Each distinct ordinary hostile projectile entering R of you makes one named 15% roll to vanish and leave a scar. Failed projectiles are not rerolled by remaining nearby. Proc chance is defensive and uses P=1.

nodes.name: Denial
nodes.tooltip: Nearby hostile projectiles move 30% slower.
nodes.rules: Ordinary hostile projectiles inside R move 30% slower. Each failed Misfire raises the next distinct projectile’s Misfire chance by 5 percentage points, up to +25; a success clears the bonus. If Misfire is absent, only the slow applies.

nodes.name: Causal Debt
nodes.tooltip: Magic Core hits save 25% of their actual damage as Debt due in 2s.
nodes.rules: Magic Core hits save 25% of their actual damage as Debt due in 2s. Debt adds damage; it does not subtract from the initial hit. Generated hits qualify only when a rule grants Magic Core eligibility. Each damage event deposits once; Debt payloads never deposit through this node.

nodes.name: Interest
nodes.tooltip: Enemy Debt grows by 15% per elapsed second, simple rather than compound interest, to +45%.
nodes.rules: Enemy Debt grows by 15% per elapsed second, simple rather than compound interest, to +45%. If a target dies before payment, gain self-Debt worth 1% maximum HP per unpaid time bucket, maximum 8% HP from one target, due in 3s. Self-Debt is a health payment and cannot generate Force or more Debt.

nodes.name: Contradiction
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core hit also applies a 15% slow for 2s.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core hit also applies a 15% slow for 2s. A generated hit against an enemy with two distinct ordinary statuses consumes the shorter remaining status to release a 0.8D Magic impact plus its remaining damage, Proc Power 0.4. One Contradiction per target per hit path. Supplies a slow; buy Residue or bring another item status to form the pair.

nodes.name: Back Pay
nodes.tooltip: Debt maturing on a corpse transfers once to the nearest living enemy within 3R, retaining 75% damage and maturing immediately.
nodes.rules: Debt maturing on a corpse transfers once to the nearest living enemy within 3R, retaining 75% damage and maturing immediately. With no target, keep it at the corpse for 2s before expiring. Packet identity persists; that packet cannot transfer through Back Pay twice.

nodes.name: Bad Luck
nodes.tooltip: Each failed named combat roll adds one shared Misfortune.
nodes.rules: Each failed named combat roll adds one shared Misfortune. At five, spend five to guarantee the next eligible combat effect and double that payload’s Proc Power, maximum 1. Guaranteed outcomes do not roll, fail or add Misfortune. Owns the same fallback check as Second Chance, never a second fallback.

nodes.name: Scar Tissue
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core impact touching scars consumes them and releases each stored scar as a 0.5D + stored-magnitude impact in R, then deposits 0.5D Debt on every enemy hit.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core impact touching scars consumes them and releases each stored scar as a 0.5D + stored-magnitude impact in R, then deposits 0.5D Debt on every enemy hit. Empty Misfire scars store 0.3D. Each scar is consumed once.

nodes.name: Compound Interest
nodes.tooltip: A Debt kill adds a new 50%-damage packet to every enemy within 2R currently bearing at least two ordinary statuses.
nodes.rules: A Debt kill adds a new 50%-damage packet to every enemy within 2R currently bearing at least two ordinary statuses. Each real victim seeds this family once; new Debt kills may seed it again. New packets have a new 1s due time and can use Back Pay.

nodes.name: Coin
nodes.tooltip: Q: flip one fair Coin; recovery 9s.
nodes.rules: Q: flip one fair Coin; recovery 9s. Heads lasts 3s: named combat checks from Core strikes are guaranteed, Twice repeats even if unowned, and critical Core hits deposit 0.5D Debt immediately. Tails pays 12% current HP and grants +60% Magic Core damage, +40% area and 0.3D Debt per Core strike for 3s. Each real kill returns 1% maximum HP, up to the health actually paid. Boss damage returns 1% per 3D dealt, same pool. Guaranteed results do not count as successful rolls for Loaded Dice.

nodes.name: Weighted
nodes.tooltip: Heads face chance becomes 75%.
nodes.rules: Heads face chance becomes 75%. Its guarantee becomes +40 percentage points to eligible combat chances, capped at 95%; Twice gets this chance even if otherwise unowned. Heads lasts 4s. Face selection is not modified by ordinary Luck.

nodes.name: Double or Nothing
nodes.tooltip: After a result containing Tails, tap Q within 1s to flip one more Coin without starting another recovery.
nodes.rules: After a result containing Tails, tap Q within 1s to flip one more Coin without starting another recovery. This option appears once per manual activation. Additional Heads adds its state; additional Tails pays another 12% current HP and adds another +60% Magic damage and +40% area. Duration restarts at 3s; paid-health refund pool combines actual payments.

nodes.name: House Edge
nodes.tooltip: Flipping consumes ordinary hostile projectiles within 2R.
nodes.rules: Flipping consumes ordinary hostile projectiles within 2R. Each group of up to four becomes one scar storing 0.2D per projectile. Consume projectiles before health payment, without treating their removal as damage prevention.

nodes.name: Two Coins
nodes.tooltip: Initial activation flips twice.
nodes.rules: Initial activation flips twice. Different faces grant both states. Two Heads last 6s; two Tails apply two sequential current-health payments and double the additive bonus. Double or Nothing adds one extra Coin total, not one per face.

nodes.name: Counterfeit
nodes.tooltip: Tap Q for Heads; hold 0.25s for Tails.
nodes.rules: Tap Q for Heads; hold 0.25s for Tails. Face states last half their ordinary duration. With Two Coins, tap gives two Heads and hold gives two Tails. Double or Nothing still offers a chosen extra face. Chosen faces are not Luck successes.

nodes.name: Bad Penny
nodes.tooltip: Each real kill during Coin sends a lesser Coin to another enemy within 3R: alternate 0.6D immediate Debt and a 1D explosion in R.
nodes.rules: Each real kill during Coin sends a lesser Coin to another enemy within 3R: alternate 0.6D immediate Debt and a 1D explosion in R. Proc Power 0.3. Lesser-Coin kills can continue the family while the state remains active; they never flip the player’s Coin or pay health.

nodes.name: Undo
nodes.tooltip: Once per 12s, surviving enemy damage totaling 25% maximum HP within 1s is restored as health and scheduled as self-Debt due in 3s.
nodes.rules: Once per 12s, surviving enemy damage totaling 25% maximum HP within 1s is restored as health and scheduled as self-Debt due in 3s. Restoration cannot exceed the actual health lost. Killing the greatest contributor cancels half; each 2D dealt to it cancels another 10%, up to all. Does not rescue an already lethal hit.

nodes.name: Pass It On
nodes.tooltip: When an indebted target dies early, move its unpaid Debt to up to three enemies within 3R.
nodes.rules: When an indebted target dies early, move its unpaid Debt to up to three enemies within 3R. Each receives 40% of the remaining amount, due in 0.5s. This replaces Interest’s self-Debt from that death. The copied packets record the dead victim; a later fresh victim may pass them on again.

nodes.name: Loaded Dice
nodes.tooltip: A rolled success creates a payload with +50% damage and +50% Proc Power, maximum 1.
nodes.rules: A rolled success creates a payload with +50% damage and +50% Proc Power, maximum 1. Every actual failed named combat roll pays 1% maximum HP, at most once per 0.5s; excess failures do not queue payments. It can kill. Guaranteed outcomes receive neither bonus nor payment. Only registered combat rolls qualify.

nodes.name: Snake Eyes
nodes.tooltip: After all ordinary chance modifiers, every non-guaranteed named combat chance becomes exactly 50%, then receives its source Proc Power multiplier.
nodes.rules: After all ordinary chance modifiers, every non-guaranteed named combat chance becomes exactly 50%, then receives its source Proc Power multiplier. Explicit guaranteed states still win. Coin face selection and acquisition Luck are excluded.

nodes.name: Payday
nodes.tooltip: When at least twenty enemy Debt buckets are pending on camera, the next naturally matured bucket starts Payday.
nodes.rules: When at least twenty enemy Debt buckets are pending on camera, the next naturally matured bucket starts Payday. Mature all pending enemy Debt oldest-first over 0.5s; newly transferred packets also join until no immediately due packets remain. Future-due Compound Interest packets wait normally. A lone durable target can trigger it after eight naturally matured buckets in 4s. Recovery 8s; this changes timing, not Debt damage.

nodes.name: REWRITE
nodes.tooltip: For 4s, all visible enemies first receive 1D Debt; named combat checks from Core strikes are guaranteed, Twice always fires, new enemy Debt matures immediately, and ordinary hostile projectiles entering the screen become scars.
nodes.rules: For 4s, all visible enemies first receive 1D Debt; named combat checks from Core strikes are guaranteed, Twice always fires, new enemy Debt matures immediately, and ordinary hostile projectiles entering the screen become scars. Normals’ melee swings miss; elite and boss attacks still work. There is no invented hidden failed-roll bill and no one-packet boss cap. V-created outcomes retain V ancestry.

nodes.name: No Exceptions
nodes.tooltip: REWRITE also guarantees registered checks from generated attacks.
nodes.rules: REWRITE also guarantees registered checks from generated attacks. Those success payloads use half their own ordinary Proc Power. The guarantee does not remove same-family hit-path protection.

nodes.name: Replay
nodes.tooltip: Each real death during REWRITE replays its last three received non-Replay hits at the corpse location, at 35% damage with original geometry and Proc Power 0.3.
nodes.rules: Each real death during REWRITE replays its last three received non-Replay hits at the corpse location, at 35% damage with original geometry and Proc Power 0.3. Replays can cause new kills and other kill families; those kills cannot record Replay damage for later replay.

nodes.name: The Bill
nodes.tooltip: Double Debt damage during REWRITE.
nodes.rules: Double Debt damage during REWRITE. At its end, pay 40% maximum HP plus 2% per enemy still carrying V-created Debt, maximum 70%. Each real kill during the state reduces this bill by 1 percentage point; each 5D dealt to elites/bosses reduces it by one more, minimum zero. A meter previews the bill. Payment can kill.

nodes.name: Fixed Coin
nodes.tooltip: Heads also banks 30% of enemy damage suffered as a separate refund due when the state ends, provided you survive.
nodes.rules: Heads also banks 30% of enemy damage suffered as a separate refund due when the state ends, provided you survive. Tails pauses existing self-Debt for its duration and directs canceled Undo debt into a 2R enemy blast worth 1D per 5% maximum HP canceled. The refund cannot repay health payments.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Counterfeit chooses the protection. Weighted is incompatible. Two Coins extends Heads or doubles the Tails bonus normally; refund percentage remains 30%. Double or Nothing, House Edge and Bad Penny retain their rules.

nodes.name: Loaded Coin
nodes.tooltip: Coin also tags enemies hit during its state.
nodes.rules: Coin also tags enemies hit during its state. When a tagged enemy dies, its unpaid Debt becomes one 1.5R blast dealing 75% of that Debt, then Pass It On transfers its ordinary shares. If the target had no unpaid Debt, the blast deals 0.5D. Each real victim triggers once.
nodes.evolution_mutations: All compatible Coin mutations retain their face behavior. Lesser Coins tag their targets and may continue the death chain. Counterfeit still shortens the state; Two Coins does not duplicate a victim’s blast.

nodes.name: Late Payment
nodes.tooltip: Causal Debt accepts Melee and Ranged Core hits at half its ordinary fraction, 12.5% of actual hit damage.
nodes.rules: Causal Debt accepts Melee and Ranged Core hits at half its ordinary fraction, 12.5% of actual hit damage. Native Magic remains at 25%. Debt-generated hits never deposit through Causal Debt.

nodes.name: Roll Chance
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: named combat chances gain a total 25 percentage points × rank/(rank+80), before Snake Eyes and Proc Power.
nodes.rules: Repeatable: named combat chances gain a total 25 percentage points × rank/(rank+80), before Snake Eyes and Proc Power. Non-guaranteed outcomes cap at 95%. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Debt Damage
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: Debt damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: Debt damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank). No automatic increase to delay. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Gravity Well
nodes.tooltip: Every third weighted Magic Core hit leaves a Well at the impact.
nodes.rules: Every third weighted Magic Core hit leaves a Well at the impact. At most one per activation; excess progress is banked. Placement deals 0.5D in its area, Proc Power 0.4. Eligible free starter.

nodes.name: Dead Weight
nodes.tooltip: Every enemy resisting a pull grants the resisted distance as Weight, up to 3L.
nodes.rules: Every enemy resisting a pull grants the resisted distance as Weight, up to 3L. The next pull spends up to L to increase normal travel by that amount or add 20% of a boss stagger bar per L. Only the initiating pull spends; Link copies do not spend again.

nodes.name: Lingering Weight
nodes.tooltip: Expired Wells leave a stain for 4s.
nodes.rules: Expired Wells leave a stain for 4s. A new Well within 2R consumes the nearest stain and pulls once along the old-to-new line, dealing 0.5D to crossed enemies. Stains cap at six; overflow replaces the oldest. Compel grants the base Well source even if Gravity Well and Crowded Well are absent.

nodes.name: Collision
nodes.tooltip: Each forced-moving normal that crosses another enemy deals 0.6D to both once per movement instruction, Proc Power 0.3.
nodes.rules: Each forced-moving normal that crosses another enemy deals 0.6D to both once per movement instruction, Proc Power 0.3. Choose the first crossed enemy by travel distance, ties by spawn ID. This is one collision per moving body, not every possible pair.

nodes.name: Bind
nodes.tooltip: A Magic Core impact hitting two enemies links them for 3s; subsequent members hit by that same activation join up to twelve.
nodes.rules: A Magic Core impact hitting two enemies links them for 3s; subsequent members hit by that same activation join up to twelve. If the native strike is single-target, two enemies hit within 0.75s count as one binding opportunity. Shared slow uses the strongest magnitude and remaining duration; hard controls follow the shared control-recovery rule.

nodes.name: Dragnet
nodes.tooltip: A pulled enemy crossing a Linked enemy joins its group if there is room, inheriting remaining life.
nodes.rules: A pulled enemy crossing a Linked enemy joins its group if there is room, inheriting remaining life. It never refreshes a Link. Also give an unlinked enemy pulled through two others a new 2s Link with those bodies, so the pull route can begin links without Bind.

nodes.name: Collective Burden
nodes.tooltip: Copy 20% of actual damage dealt to a Linked enemy to every other member, Proc Power 0.25.
nodes.rules: Copy 20% of actual damage dealt to a Linked enemy to every other member, Proc Power 0.25. These copies cannot call Collective Burden again. They can kill, trigger other families and create fresh direct damage from those families. Damage is copied once per member; adding members intentionally multiplies the total payoff.

nodes.name: Crushing
nodes.tooltip: Each Well containing four enemies shrinks its radius by 20% and hits its center for 0.5D every 0.3s, up to four hits.
nodes.rules: Each Well containing four enemies shrinks its radius by 20% and hits its center for 0.5D every 0.3s, up to four hits. When its center empties or it expires, release 0.5D per completed hit outward in 2R. Proc Power 0.3. One shrink per Well.

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.tooltip: The highest-maximum-health enemy in a Well becomes its Anchor.
nodes.rules: The highest-maximum-health enemy in a Well becomes its Anchor. Pull everyone toward its current position; a moving Anchor drags the Well at up to L/s. A boss Anchor receives +25% stagger from that Well.

nodes.name: Throw
nodes.tooltip: Normals hitting terrain during a forced move store one throw.
nodes.rules: Normals hitting terrain during a forced move store one throw. At movement end they fly another R in the chosen direction, dealing 0.8D to each enemy crossed, Proc Power 0.3. A body can receive one Throw per instruction; Throw itself cannot create another stored throw.

nodes.name: Collapse
nodes.tooltip: The first real death in a Link pulls its surviving members R toward the corpse, then breaks that Link.
nodes.rules: The first real death in a Link pulls its surviving members R toward the corpse, then breaks that Link. Each member takes 0.8D, Proc Power 0.4. New Core hits or a later Compel may establish a new Link; Collapse cannot recreate its own group.

nodes.name: Crowded Well
nodes.tooltip: After a dash, the next Magic Core impact creates a Well.
nodes.rules: After a dash, the next Magic Core impact creates a Well. Every enemy inside any Well adds 5% radius, up to +60%, while pull speed falls by 2% each, at most 24%. Replaces no existing source; both source counters can qualify, but one activation places only one Well and banks the other.

nodes.name: Compel
nodes.tooltip: Q: pull enemies in a 90-degree, 3R cone toward the cursor, up to R of movement, dealing 1D and interrupting ordinary actions.
nodes.rules: Q: pull enemies in a 90-degree, 3R cone toward the cursor, up to R of movement, dealing 1D and interrupting ordinary actions. Leave a base Well at convergence, even on an empty cast. Recovery 6s. Elite/boss displacement uses resistance conversion.

nodes.name: Ring
nodes.tooltip: Compel becomes a 2.5R circle centered on the cursor within 3L.
nodes.rules: Compel becomes a 2.5R circle centered on the cursor within 3L. Direction remains toward its center unless Repulse reverses it.

nodes.name: Chain
nodes.tooltip: Affected enemies form Links of twelve in distance-to-center order, for 3s.
nodes.rules: Affected enemies form Links of twelve in distance-to-center order, for 3s. Existing groups merge only when total membership fits; otherwise preserve separate groups. No target belongs to two groups.

nodes.name: Repulse
nodes.tooltip: Hold Q for 0.3s to shove outward instead.
nodes.rules: Hold Q for 0.3s to shove outward instead. Ring becomes a full circular shove. Tap retains ordinary pull. Automatic casts use the chosen loadout default: Pull or Push.

nodes.name: Repeat
nodes.tooltip: After 1s, Compel repeats at 60% damage and movement in the opposite direction at the same center.
nodes.rules: After 1s, Compel repeats at 60% damage and movement in the opposite direction at the same center. It retains the original Q ancestry and does not count as a new activation.

nodes.name: Throw
nodes.tooltip: Bodies reaching the convergence point continue another 1.5R toward the cursor’s far side, or outward with Repulse.
nodes.rules: Bodies reaching the convergence point continue another 1.5R toward the cursor’s far side, or outward with Repulse. Each deals 0.8D to crossed enemies. This Q throw and the local Throw share a one-throw-per-body budget per movement instruction; Q uses the greater travel distance.

nodes.name: Crush
nodes.tooltip: Enemies reaching the center take 1D +0.25D per distinct body moved, maximum 6D.
nodes.rules: Enemies reaching the center take 1D +0.25D per distinct body moved, maximum 6D. With Repulse the payoff occurs in the outer rim. A boss that cannot move takes the hit at its actual location and contributes one body.

nodes.name: Singularity
nodes.tooltip: A Well containing six normals immediately compresses them to its center, deals 1.5D and stuns for 0.5s, then expires.
nodes.rules: A Well containing six normals immediately compresses them to its center, deals 1.5D and stuns for 0.5s, then expires. Elites/bosses contribute two/four bodies to the threshold but receive ordinary resistance conversion. Black Hole, when ready, takes precedence over this expiry.

nodes.name: Forced Orbit
nodes.tooltip: Wells move normals around their center for 2s instead of pulling straight inward.
nodes.rules: Wells move normals around their center for 2s instead of pulling straight inward. They cannot attack for only the first 0.5s, then can attack while orbiting. Elites orbit 0.25s; bosses feed stagger. Throw releases tangentially on expiry.

nodes.name: Sovereign Ground
nodes.tooltip: Standing still for 0.75s leaves a 2R territory for 5s, at most two.
nodes.rules: Standing still for 0.75s leaves a 2R territory for 5s, at most two. Inside it, pull speed and Collective Burden fraction gain +50%. Outside all territory, Dominion damage is reduced by 25%. Territories do not follow you.

nodes.name: Event Horizon
nodes.tooltip: Well acquisition radius becomes the visible camera; its damage radius remains ordinary.
nodes.rules: Well acquisition radius becomes the visible camera; its damage radius remains ordinary. At expiry collapse for 2D in 2R. The strongest Well also pulls you at 0.5L/s and prevents dashing during its final 0.5s. Its countdown and player path are always visible.

nodes.name: Black Hole
nodes.tooltip: A Well containing twenty normals or eight Linked enemies becomes a Black Hole for 1s, pulling from camera edges and consuming ordinary hostile projectiles.
nodes.rules: A Well containing twenty normals or eight Linked enemies becomes a Black Hole for 1s, pulling from camera edges and consuming ordinary hostile projectiles. At collapse deal 2D +0.3D per distinct enemy caught, maximum 8D per target, in 3R. Every target can also receive Collective Burden copies from the other hits. A lone boss qualifies after absorbing 3L resisted travel in 4s. Recovery 8s; Proc Power 0.3.

nodes.name: KNEEL
nodes.tooltip: Pull all visible normals to the cursor, hold 0.5s, then slam for 4D +0.2D per distinct normal caught, maximum 12D per target.
nodes.rules: Pull all visible normals to the cursor, hold 0.5s, then slam for 4D +0.2D per distinct normal caught, maximum 12D per target. Elites move at most R and receive the slam; bosses receive the slam at their actual position plus 40% stagger. Form temporary Links in groups of twelve if Bind, Dragnet or Chain is owned. Proc Power 0.2; all descendants keep V ancestry.

nodes.name: Pile
nodes.tooltip: Slam victims leave corpse weight for 5s.
nodes.rules: Slam victims leave corpse weight for 5s. Up to twenty corpses count toward Crowded Well and the next Black Hole threshold; each can be spent once for +0.1D to that collapse. Corpses are not new deaths and cannot trigger on-kill effects again.

nodes.name: Orbit
nodes.tooltip: Before the slam, normals orbit for 1.5s and each ranged normal fires one ordinary hostile projectile outward at the midpoint.
nodes.rules: Before the slam, normals orbit for 1.5s and each ranged normal fires one ordinary hostile projectile outward at the midpoint. Slam damage gains +50%. These projectiles remain dangerous and can be caught or consumed normally.

nodes.name: Again
nodes.tooltip: Survivors are thrown up to 3R outward and pulled back for a second slam at 60% damage after 1s.
nodes.rules: Survivors are thrown up to 3R outward and pulled back for a second slam at 60% damage after 1s. Bosses take the repeat in place. Second slam keeps V ancestry and uses the original body count.

nodes.name: Mass Grave
nodes.tooltip: Compel creates a 3R grave for 3s at convergence.
nodes.rules: Compel creates a 3R grave for 3s at convergence. Each real death in it pulls surviving enemies R and deals 1D in the center. Each victim triggers once; new kills can continue. A single elite/boss instead triggers one pulse per 3D of Core damage, at most once per 0.5s.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Ring widens acquisition. Chain creates Links. Repulse makes grave pulses push. Repeat creates a second pulse at the original grave. Throw launches bodies after Crush; it does not delete the grave.

nodes.name: Crowd Pinball
nodes.tooltip: Compel places two bumpers 2R apart for 3s.
nodes.rules: Compel places two bumpers 2R apart for 3s. Affected normals travel between them twice, triggering Collision on each leg. Their final hit launches them tangentially for 1D. Elites move one short leg; bosses take two 1D bumper impacts and resisted-travel stagger.
nodes.evolution_mutations: Ring acquires in a circle. Chain binds the riders. Repulse starts at the opposite bumper. Repeat grants one extra leg. Throw adds 1.5R to the exit; Crush occurs at the final bumper.

nodes.name: Common Ground
nodes.tooltip: Melee and Ranged Core strikes may Bind through the same rules as Magic.
nodes.rules: Melee and Ranged Core strikes may Bind through the same rules as Magic. A penetrating projectile can build one Link along its path; a wide melee swing binds its victims. Damage copying still requires Collective Burden.

nodes.name: Pull
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: pull speed gains 80% × rank/(rank+100).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: pull speed gains 80% × rank/(rank+100). Control duration and boss stagger do not scale with this sink. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Link Life
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: Link life gains 2s × rank/(rank+70).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: Link life gains 2s × rank/(rank+70). Joining a Link still never refreshes it. Price 200 × (rank+1)^1.25.

nodes.name: Open a Gate
nodes.tooltip: Choose one unopened Core.
nodes.rules: Choose one unopened Core. Gain its access anchor and one Witness strike every fourth native attack activation: Slash, Shot or Impact. The strike deals 0.6D at Proc Power 0.6, has real foreign geometry, and qualifies for that Core’s strike rules. It is not a native input. Requires four local nodes in your native Core, plus an owned native Q or Keystone. Costs 1,600 Followers.

nodes.name: Open the Last Gate
nodes.tooltip: Choose the remaining Core.
nodes.rules: Choose the remaining Core. Gain a second Witness strike, alternating with the first every second native attack; each foreign Core therefore still attacks once per four inputs. All three borders become accessible. Requires one Revelation and one Fusion, plus the first Gate. Costs 4,800 Followers.

nodes.name: Bloodshot
nodes.tooltip: Spillover becomes a piercing blood shot with two additional pierces.
nodes.rules: Spillover becomes a piercing blood shot with two additional pierces. Capture the initiating victim’s overkill once; each pierced target takes that stored damage. Fresh kills can create fresh Spillover shots. Proc Power 0.6.

nodes.name: Kill Feed
nodes.tooltip: Fragments may apply Finish to normals at half your current execute line.
nodes.rules: Fragments may apply Finish to normals at half your current execute line. Each fragment execution grants one extra fragment, in addition to the ordinary pair; every new body may continue. Proc Power 0.4. Extra fragments do not duplicate that victim’s ordinary pair.

nodes.name: Corpse Mortar
nodes.tooltip: An executed victim launches its Corpse Bomb toward the nearest living cluster within 4R instead of exploding in place.
nodes.rules: An executed victim launches its Corpse Bomb toward the nearest living cluster within 4R instead of exploding in place. It lands after 0.4s, counts as a Shell and can start Secondary Blast. Every fresh corpse is a new launch; the same corpse is never used twice.

nodes.name: Rail Dash
nodes.tooltip: Dashing alongside a returning projectile catches up to three returns in R.
nodes.rules: Dashing alongside a returning projectile catches up to three returns in R. Release them from the dash endpoint toward aim at +0.5D and their original return coefficient. This redirects actual projectiles without duplicating hits already dealt. Long Step lengthens the collection route.

nodes.name: Run and Gun
nodes.tooltip: Every Afterimage fires one 0.6D Ranged shot toward current aim when it slashes.
nodes.rules: Every Afterimage fires one 0.6D Ranged shot toward current aim when it slashes. Every third Crossfire shot leaves one 0.5D Melee Afterimage at its origin. The two conversion families can each occur once on one hit path; kills may continue other families. Proc Power 0.4 for both.

nodes.name: Mine Runner
nodes.tooltip: Ramming a normal attaches one newly created Mine to it.
nodes.rules: Ramming a normal attaches one newly created Mine to it. The Mine arms at the endpoint and detonates on its first body collision or after 0.5s. It counts toward the ordinary Mine capacity. A dash crossing an existing Mine can carry it instead of creating a second.

nodes.name: Countershot
nodes.tooltip: Reflected projectiles expose their first target after dealing damage.
nodes.rules: Reflected projectiles expose their first target after dealing damage. A reflected shot consuming an existing Weak Point then returns once for 0.8D at Proc Power 0.5. Return shots may hit that target again but cannot reflect themselves.

nodes.name: Heavy Barrel
nodes.tooltip: A Jam spends up to 60 Force, split once across its ordinary rounds as +0.06D per Force.
nodes.rules: A Jam spends up to 60 Force, split once across its ordinary rounds as +0.06D per Force. At 60 spent, each Jam round pierces once. Overload can use the same damage bonus snapshot at half value, without another spend. Heat and Force remain separate pools.

nodes.name: Reactive Armor
nodes.tooltip: Enemy damage prevented by Guard, Plate or a Force plate creates one Mine at your feet per 10% maximum HP prevented, banking fractions.
nodes.rules: Enemy damage prevented by Guard, Plate or a Force plate creates one Mine at your feet per 10% maximum HP prevented, banking fractions. Maximum three per incoming hit. Self-damage and virtual on-block events cannot create these Mines. They use Chain Reaction normally.

nodes.name: Blood Rite
nodes.tooltip: A Sigil pulse consumes one Growth to raise Finish’s execute line against its hit targets by 3 percentage points for 2s, up to +9 per target.
nodes.rules: A Sigil pulse consumes one Growth to raise Finish’s execute line against its hit targets by 3 percentage points for 2s, up to +9 per target. Executions within the Sigil return two Growth, shared by Congregation. The bonus raises the threshold; it does not make executions harder.

nodes.name: Death Debt
nodes.tooltip: Executing a target turns its unpaid Debt into a 1.5R explosion for the full stored amount, minimum 0.5D, then marks the original buckets as paid.
nodes.rules: Executing a target turns its unpaid Debt into a 1.5R explosion for the full stored amount, minimum 0.5D, then marks the original buckets as paid. With Pass It On, transfer its ordinary shares before marking paid. New victims can repeat. Proc Power 0.4; Interest does not create a self-bill for Debt paid by this explosion.

nodes.name: Corpse Well
nodes.tooltip: Every Corpse Bomb leaves a 1s Well before detonating, pulling bodies toward the corpse.
nodes.rules: Every Corpse Bomb leaves a 1s Well before detonating, pulling bodies toward the corpse. The bomb waits for the pull, then resolves at +25% radius. A corpse cannot create another corpse of itself. Black Hole may take over this Well if ready.

nodes.name: Riftwalk
nodes.tooltip: Dashing through a Sigil moves it with you to the endpoint and commands one pulse there.
nodes.rules: Dashing through a Sigil moves it with you to the endpoint and commands one pulse there. It retains life, Growth and Echoes. Maximum three Sigils per dash; Home Rune can continue following afterward. The dash is one movement event, not a teleport-created extra dash.

nodes.name: Double Step
nodes.tooltip: Twice may repeat a dash’s endpoint slash at its starting point for 0.6D.
nodes.rules: Twice may repeat a dash’s endpoint slash at its starting point for 0.6D. On a successful Twice roll, leave an Afterimage there even if the repeated slash misses. These copies never move the player or create another dash; Proc Power 0.5.

nodes.name: Slingshot
nodes.tooltip: Entering a Well at 60+ Momentum bends your dash halfway around its center, then releases toward aim.
nodes.rules: Entering a Well at 60+ Momentum bends your dash halfway around its center, then releases toward aim. Carried normals follow the same arc and collide at the exit. Hold away from the Well to refuse capture. Missing the aimed exit carries you another R tangentially. Claims Momentum.

nodes.name: Ward
nodes.tooltip: While inside a grown Sigil, Plate reforms in 1s instead of 2s.
nodes.rules: While inside a grown Sigil, Plate reforms in 1s instead of 2s. When Plate breaks there, store a 1D Echo and add two Growth. Warm Circle and Plate multiply their prevention in the standard defense order; they do not each claim the entire prevented amount.

nodes.name: Backlash
nodes.tooltip: Thorns deposits half its dealt damage as Debt on the attacker.
nodes.rules: Thorns deposits half its dealt damage as Debt on the attacker. When that Debt matures, return 10 Force, once per original prevented hit. Debt copies preserve that refund identity. Refunds cannot trigger an automatic discharge until the current event finishes.

nodes.name: Gravity Armor
nodes.tooltip: Above 60 Force, nearby normals within R orbit you slowly.
nodes.rules: Above 60 Force, nearby normals within R orbit you slowly. Spending at least 20 Force throws up to four orbiters toward aim for 0.8D each. Above 100 Force, movement is 20% slower. Orbital motion does not repeatedly suppress attacks; only the initial 0.5s uses control recovery.

nodes.name: Spellshot
nodes.tooltip: A piercing Core projectile crossing a Sigil loads one stored Echo, consuming it.
nodes.rules: A piercing Core projectile crossing a Sigil loads one stored Echo, consuming it. On its next enemy impact it releases that Echo with the projectile’s aim. One Echo per projectile per Sigil; one projectile can collect from several Sigils. Echoes cannot reload the carrier that released them.

nodes.name: Backtrack
nodes.tooltip: A returning projectile accelerates that target’s oldest Debt bucket by 0.5s on hit.
nodes.rules: A returning projectile accelerates that target’s oldest Debt bucket by 0.5s on hit. If the bucket matures, the projectile gains +0.3D for later targets on this return, up to +2D. It never adds a new return.

nodes.name: Gravity Round
nodes.tooltip: Consuming a Weak Point leaves a Well ahead of the projectile, pulling nearby enemies into its remaining line.
nodes.rules: Consuming a Weak Point leaves a Well ahead of the projectile, pulling nearby enemies into its remaining line. Each different exposed target crossed adds R/4 acquisition radius to later Wells, up to +R. The line remains visible before the pull.

nodes.name: Bullet Runes
nodes.tooltip: Every third Crossfire shot leaves a small Sigil at its first impact, using ordinary capacity.
nodes.rules: Every third Crossfire shot leaves a small Sigil at its first impact, using ordinary capacity. A Sigil created this way fires one 0.5D Ranged shot on each pulse instead of radial pulse damage. It still stores Echoes and joins the network. These shots are generated, and cannot advance Crossfire without an explicit Core grant.

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.tooltip: Burn kills make a named 25% combat roll to throw three burning fragments, each 0.5D and the ordinary Hot Rounds Burn, Proc Power 0.4.
nodes.rules: Burn kills make a named 25% combat roll to throw three burning fragments, each 0.5D and the ordinary Hot Rounds Burn, Proc Power 0.4. Failed rolls grant Misfortune; five can guarantee the next registered effect. Each new Burn victim can continue. This node supplies the fragments and the actual roll; Fragmentation is optional.

nodes.name: Stormwire
nodes.tooltip: A Core ricochet hitting a Linked enemy travels along one unvisited Link member after its ordinary bounce for 0.5D, Proc Power 0.3.
nodes.rules: A Core ricochet hitting a Linked enemy travels along one unvisited Link member after its ordinary bounce for 0.5D, Proc Power 0.3. Each new member reached can extend the wire once, up to the group’s membership. Wire damage also shares through Collective Burden, whose copies cannot create another wire.

nodes.name: Rune Bomb
nodes.tooltip: A Mine touching a Sigil attaches to it without using an extra Sigil slot.
nodes.rules: A Mine touching a Sigil attaches to it without using an extra Sigil slot. Detonating either detonates the attached partner once. Up to three Mines attach per Sigil; surviving children inherit no copied Mines. Mine→Sigil→same Mine is forbidden, while nearby different Mines may continue Chain Reaction.

nodes.name: Time Bomb
nodes.tooltip: Secondary Blast Shells collect unpaid Debt from their initiating corpse and delay by 0.5s.
nodes.rules: Secondary Blast Shells collect unpaid Debt from their initiating corpse and delay by 0.5s. On landing add 75% of that collected damage and mature living targets’ oldest bucket. Collected buckets are consumed, so Back Pay cannot also transfer them. Death Debt has priority if both attempt to consume the same corpse.

nodes.name: Meteor
nodes.tooltip: Big One becomes a slow meteor: 6D in 2R after 1s.
nodes.rules: Big One becomes a slow meteor: 6D in 2R after 1s. A Well pulls at its landing during the tell. With Event Horizon it also pulls you; Danger Close uses the actual enlarged blast. One meteor per Big One occurrence, no meteor copied from meteor hits.

nodes.name: TOTAL OFFENSIVE
nodes.tooltip: A native attack alternates loading and firing a six-round shoulder rack.
nodes.rules: A native attack alternates loading and firing a six-round shoulder rack. Melee hits load one 0.7D round; Ranged Core hits fire one. When six are loaded, a native Melee input fires them all across its arc. At a Jam, full Force discharge or execution chain of six victims, dump the rack toward aim and instantly load three. Each trigger occurrence does this once; rounds use Proc Power 0.4.

nodes.name: INCARNATE
nodes.tooltip: Your body carries one Sigil and one Well within R, retaining their timers and capacities.
nodes.rules: Your body carries one Sigil and one Well within R, retaining their timers and capacities. A native Melee hit through either releases one stored Echo and commands one pull, at most once per native input. Taking 10% maximum HP of actual enemy damage commands both again; prevention does not count toward this threshold. Moving the carried objects is not replacement.

nodes.name: ARCANE BALLISTICS
nodes.tooltip: Every fourth native Ranged input loads the next shot with one owned spell rule, cycling Sigil, Debt and Well.
nodes.rules: Every fourth native Ranged input loads the next shot with one owned spell rule, cycling Sigil, Debt and Well. That shot places a Sigil, deposits 1D Debt or creates a Well at its first target. Skip unavailable families. A native Magic input instead fires one 1D piercing Ranged shot through aim. These are real foreign strikes at Proc Power 0.5, never new native inputs.

nodes.name: Hands On
nodes.tooltip: Manual Q casts gain +20% damage and +20% movement/pull distance.
nodes.rules: Manual Q casts gain +20% damage and +20% movement/pull distance. Automatic Q casts gain no bonus.

nodes.name: Automatic
nodes.tooltip: Your equipped Q triggers when ready using the targeting table.
nodes.rules: Your equipped Q triggers when ready using the targeting table. It uses 70% damage and 70% ordinary Proc Power, applied once. Manual Q input instead pauses automation while held; ordinary cooldown continues. Movement and health costs still happen.

nodes.name: Patient
nodes.tooltip: After at least 2s without casting Q, its next activation gains +30% damage and +30% area.
nodes.rules: After at least 2s without casting Q, its next activation gains +30% damage and +30% area. Automatic casts qualify if their actual interval meets this condition.

nodes.name: Momentum
nodes.tooltip: Every third native input after travelling L refunds 0.5s Q recovery.
nodes.rules: Every third native input after travelling L refunds 0.5s Q recovery. Distance is consumed; generated actions never add input count.

nodes.name: Fortune
nodes.tooltip: After choosing an encounter reward, reroll one unchosen ordinary item reward once, keeping either result.
nodes.rules: After choosing an encounter reward, reroll one unchosen ordinary item reward once, keeping either result. One use per reward screen; cannot reroll Evolution recipes or duplicate the chosen reward.

nodes.name: Commitment
nodes.tooltip: Equip only one Keystone to strengthen its beneficial numeric values by 25%.
nodes.rules: Equip only one Keystone to strengthen its beneficial numeric values by 25%. Costs and drawbacks remain full strength. Discrete object counts round down after modification; event rules and guaranteed chances do not change.

nodes.name: Encore
nodes.tooltip: After a Revelation ends, your next manual Q within 4s repeats once after 0.4s at 50% damage, preserving one Q activation/root.
nodes.rules: After a Revelation ends, your next manual Q within 4s repeats once after 0.4s at 50% damage, preserving one Q activation/root. Health costs are paid only by the opening Q.

nodes.name: Overflow
nodes.tooltip: At full Revelation charge, further eligible charge stores up to 25 reserve.
nodes.rules: At full Revelation charge, further eligible charge stores up to 25 reserve. Casting spends the main meter and immediately transfers reserve into it. V descendants still cannot charge or fill reserve.

nodes.name: Wild Card
nodes.tooltip: The next Evolution reward offers every qualified Evolution instead of three.
nodes.rules: The next Evolution reward offers every qualified Evolution instead of three. Choose one; afterward each normal Evolution reward still offers up to three. No recipe is granted without its prerequisites.

nodes.name: ASCENDANT
nodes.tooltip: Every native attack now emits one real strike from each foreign Core at 0.45D, Proc Power 0.45, replacing the alternating Witness schedule.
nodes.rules: Every native attack now emits one real strike from each foreign Core at 0.45D, Proc Power 0.45, replacing the alternating Witness schedule. Unlock a third Keystone slot, one Reaction Q and a second Revelation slot. No new primary weapon is equipped. Choose one of the three Ascendant adaptations for free. The world queues its next institutional response after the current reward/breather; it does not immediately erase your power spike.

nodes.name: Echoes
nodes.tooltip: Foreign Ascendant strikes repeat after 0.3s at 50% damage and Proc Power 0.25.
nodes.rules: Foreign Ascendant strikes repeat after 0.3s at 50% damage and Proc Power 0.25. They remain generated Core strikes and cannot produce another Ascendant strike.

nodes.name: Second Skin
nodes.tooltip: Once per 15s, a surviving enemy hit of at least 15% maximum HP commands the equipped Reaction Q immediately, bypassing its remaining recovery.
nodes.rules: Once per 15s, a surviving enemy hit of at least 15% maximum HP commands the equipped Reaction Q immediately, bypassing its remaining recovery. Its next recovery doubles. Health payments cannot trigger this.

nodes.name: Chain Reaction
nodes.tooltip: A root killing twenty distinct enemies commands one additional 2D foreign strike at the nearest survivor, cycling Cores.
nodes.rules: A root killing twenty distinct enemies commands one additional 2D foreign strike at the nearest survivor, cycling Cores. Each fresh twenty-body milestone may repeat. These strikes retain the original ancestry; the reward is allowed to extend the avalanche.

nodes.name: Power
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: all damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: all damage gains 0.5% × sqrt(rank). Price 1,000 × (rank+1)^1.4. This is additive with other tree damage bonuses, not recursive proc multiplication.

nodes.name: Recovery
nodes.tooltip: Repeatable: ordinary Q recovery is reduced by 20% × rank/(rank+100).
nodes.rules: Repeatable: ordinary Q recovery is reduced by 20% × rank/(rank+100). This affects the base before Reaction Q’s multiplier. Never changes Revelation charge or catastrophe recovery. Price 1,000 × (rank+1)^1.4.

builds.name: Blood domino
builds.equip: Gavel Chain; DECIMATION; no Keystone required
builds.play: Wound a pack with Gavel, execute one, then let Spillover and new Gavels jump through fresh bodies. Red Mist is an earned wipe before V.
builds.adapt: Corpse Mortar is a route if artillery catalysts arrive. Better direct damage helps start chains against a tougher wave.
builds.risk: A wave with no wounded starter can stall the cascade; kill the weakest member first.

builds.name: Endless Lunge
builds.play: Aim successive returns through new victims. Afterimages make the path dangerous and six returns finish in Blade Storm.
builds.adapt: Movement and trail effects favor long routes; a boss can instead justify Fork and Crash Run after a respec.
builds.risk: Missing ends the manual chain. Hold a safe dash for the gap after BLINK.

builds.name: Bomb suit
builds.play: Build Force, hold the bunker, then remotely detonate a stored hit and Meltdown. RUPTURE works even when the tank is empty.
builds.adapt: Mirror is valuable against shooters; stationary protection changes whether Overpressure is worth holding.
builds.risk: Damage above 100 Force is more dangerous; a quiet encounter fills slowly.

builds.name: Kill Line
builds.play: Line enemies up so the first shot exposes and returns through them. Deadshot kills redraw new lines through the horde.
builds.adapt: Fan helps broad packs; against one large target, several manually aligned JUDGEMENT lines are preferable to Auto-Plot.
builds.risk: Terrain and angle matter. A field of isolated durable enemies provides fewer redraws.

builds.name: Bullet Hell
builds.play: Fragments bounce into fresh victims, growing rotating guns during Burst. Backfire and Overload turn the eventual Jam into a second attack.
builds.adapt: Heat control may delay the desired Jam: read the preview before taking cooling equipment.
builds.risk: Jam is still a real firing gap; health payment accumulates if healing cannot keep up.

builds.name: Carpet Bomb
builds.play: Draw the route of Coordinates, lay mines, then stop to unload the remaining Shells. Blast kills call more Shells.
builds.adapt: Guidance/Bunker Buster is the alternative for mobile elites; Slay the Spire-style encounter preview should make the swap understandable.
builds.risk: Poor placement wastes delayed damage; Danger Close would require a visible escape lane.

builds.name: Sigil Web
builds.play: Grow parents in a dense fight, let them create children, then command crossing lines and Choir. THE HOST multiplies the prepared field.
builds.adapt: Consume gives immediate relocation damage but spends the old network; healing supports Blood Rune later.
builds.risk: A moving objective can leave the field behind. Preparation must survive long enough to matter.

builds.name: Loaded Coin
builds.play: Apply Fading and slow, seed Debt, then let an early kill pass it to three more victims. Coin turns those transfers into blasts.
builds.adapt: More status items widen Compound Interest. Counterfeit buys control at the cost of duration.
builds.risk: Interest without Pass It On can leave a health bill. Loaded Dice should be selected only with a plan to pay.

builds.name: Mass Grave
builds.play: Link a crowd, pull it into the grave and use each collapse to feed the next. Shared damage makes density a damage multiplier.
builds.adapt: Forced Orbit/Crowd Pinball is the movement alternative; extra projectiles reward Event Horizon preparation.
builds.risk: A lone boss loses the crowd multiplier and uses the resisted-pull trigger instead.

builds.name: Running guns
builds.play: Afterimages slash and fire. Crossfire periodically puts another Afterimage at the edge of the screen, making movement leave a spreading firing formation.
builds.adapt: Later buy Moving Fire and more Barrage locals if Ranged item triggers become the run’s best source.
builds.risk: The foreign shots are slower before Ascendant; do not budget native-gun fire rate for Witness.

builds.name: Corpse artillery
builds.play: The first execution launches a corpse at a distant group. Mortar kills call more Shells; Execution continues inside the new crowd.
builds.adapt: Falling Gavel is available after Meat, Drop and Big One investment; the current Blood fork would require respec.
builds.risk: A corpse travels before exploding, giving mobile targets a chance to escape.

builds.name: Death Debt
builds.play: Witness seeds Debt between melee inputs. Execute an indebted target to turn its remaining bill into an explosion and transfer shares to new targets.
builds.adapt: Late Payment needs five Distortion locals and makes every native melee strike deposit Debt.
builds.risk: Before the Axiom, only the foreign Core supplies ordinary Causal Debt; this is a functioning but slower hybrid.

builds.name: Stormwire
builds.play: Native shots Bind targets after Common Ground. Ricochets then travel through the Link, and each hit shares damage across the group.
builds.adapt: More pull gathers separated enemies; armor matters if the Link must be built in close range.
builds.risk: Shared damage cannot copy itself, and new members do not refresh Link duration.

builds.name: Spell-loaded rail
builds.play: Place a Sigil with foreign impacts and store Echoes using the foreign-echo bridge described below. Shoot through it to carry a spell down the piercing line.
builds.adapt: This complete route also buys Echo Chamber so native Ranged inputs can fill the store.
builds.risk: Empty Sigils do not invent free Echoes; a line that misses the Sigil does not load.

builds.name: Runes and mines
builds.equip: Carpet Bomb; FIRE MISSION; Witness: Impact
builds.play: Attach mines to Sigils and let either side detonate the other. Chain Reaction can extend through different Mines after one Sigil goes off.
builds.adapt: Add IN05 for growth overflow explosions or Consecrate/Consume as a manual trigger.
builds.risk: This route needs deliberate Sigil replacement or mine contact; an idle Sigil is not itself a fuse.

builds.name: Three-Core avalanche
builds.equip: Gavel Chain primary Q; Loaded Coin Reaction Q on catastrophe; DECIMATION + REWRITE; Chain Reaction adaptation
builds.play: Every native slash supplies shot and spell strikes. Fragments execute weakened normals, Debt is paid by executions, and twenty fresh bodies seed another foreign attack. Trigger REWRITE before DECIMATION to make the wipe operate the whole machine.
builds.adapt: Three Keystone slots are available but no Keystone is required for this route. Add Loaded Dice only if the visible health budget supports its failures.
builds.risk: The sequence’s descendants cannot refill either V meter. You still need ordinary fighting before the next pair.
